objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: mga katuwang sa barangay.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: barangay partners.

read_sections.body_en:
At a fictional meeting, Malou helps prepare an agreed community health activity. The group needs a space and ten chairs on Saturday morning. She first checks the number, time and participants’ preferences. The space and chairs are not yet confirmed.

A clear need guides the choice of partner. Knowing an official does not automatically give Malou equipment or permission.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa kathang-isip na pulong, tumutulong si Malou sa paghahanda ng napagkasunduang aktibidad pangkalusugan. Kailangan ng grupo ng lugar at sampung upuan sa Sabado ng umaga. Itinatanong muna niya kung tama ang bilang, oras at nais ng mga kalahok. Hindi pa kumpirmado ang lugar o mga upuan.

Ang malinaw na pangangailangan ang batayan ng pagpili ng katuwang. Hindi awtomatikong may kagamitan o pahintulot dahil may kakilalang opisyal si Malou.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Clarify the need before requesting support.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Linawin ang kailangan bago humingi ng suporta.

read_sections.body_en:
The DOH manual describes the punong barangay as a partner in health services, local leadership and administrative oversight. The health kagawad advocates health policies and resolutions in the council. Some barangays assign additional health-activity responsibilities.

Malou can ask the responsible barangay contact about space and equipment. She confirms who handles the request and which local process applies. Technical or personal health questions belong with the designated authorized health professional; an official’s position does not replace that role.
read_sections.body_fil:
Inilalarawan ng DOH manual ang punong barangay bilang katuwang sa serbisyong pangkalusugan, lokal na pamumuno at administratibong pangangasiwa. Ang kagawad sa kalusugan ay nagtataguyod ng mga polisiya at resolusyong pangkalusugan sa konseho. Sa ilang barangay, may itinalagang dagdag na tungkulin sa gawaing pangkalusugan.

Maaaring magtanong si Malou sa responsableng barangay contact tungkol sa lugar at kagamitan. Tinitiyak niya kung sino ang may saklaw sa kahilingan at anong lokal na proseso ang kailangan. Ang teknikal o personal na tanong pangkalusugan ay sa itinalagang awtorisadong health professional; hindi ito napapalitan ng katungkulan ng opisyal.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Match the need to the role; confirm local responsibility.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Itugma ang kailangan sa papel; tiyakin ang lokal na saklaw.

read_sections.body_en:
Malou explains: “We have an agreed activity on Saturday morning. We need a space and ten chairs. Who should we contact, and what steps or approval are needed?”

The purpose, time and requested support are clear. She separates known facts from what is unconfirmed: there is a request, but no approval or confirmed equipment yet. This request does not need a resident’s name or personal health information.
read_sections.body_fil:
Ipinapaliwanag ni Malou: “May napagkasunduang aktibidad sa Sabado ng umaga. Kailangan namin ng lugar at sampung upuan. Sino ang dapat lapitan, at anong hakbang o pahintulot ang kailangan?”

Malinaw ang layunin, oras at hinihinging suporta. Hiwalay ang alam sa hindi pa kumpirmado: may kahilingan, ngunit wala pang pahintulot o kumpirmadong kagamitan. Hindi niya kailangang magsama ng pangalan o personal na impormasyong pangkalusugan ng residente sa ganitong kahilingan.
read_sections.takeaway_en: State the purpose, time, support and a clarification question.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Sabihin ang layunin, oras, suporta at tanong na maglilinaw.

read_sections.body_en:
For a proposed health policy or program support, the health kagawad may be a partner in advocating it in the council. That differs from simply asking who manages a space for an activity.

Malou does not promise that one official can provide funding, payment or equipment alone. She asks what decisions, approvals and local arrangements are needed. This lesson does not give legal rules about budget appropriation or honoraria.
read_sections.body_fil:
Kung ang usapin ay mungkahing polisiya o suporta sa programang pangkalusugan, ang kagawad sa kalusugan ay maaaring maging katuwang sa pagtataguyod nito sa konseho. Iba ito sa simpleng pagtatanong kung sino ang namamahala sa lugar para sa isang aktibidad.

Hindi nangangako si Malou na isang opisyal lamang ang makapagbibigay ng pondo, bayad o kagamitan. Itinatanong niya kung anong pagpapasya, pag-apruba at lokal na kaayusan ang kailangan. Hindi nagbibigay ang araling ito ng tuntuning legal tungkol sa paglalaan ng pondo o honorarium.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Coordination and approval differ; do not promise funding.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Magkaiba ang pag-uugnay at pag-apruba; huwag mangako ng pondo.

read_sections.body_en:
Malou records the responsible contact, next step and when to ask again. If the space is unconfirmed, she tells the group. She listens to their preferences and discusses another appropriate plan if needed.

She checks actual availability and approval before saying arrangements are ready. A personal health question goes separately to an authorized professional under local arrangements. A guess or personal acquaintance is not confirmation.
read_sections.body_fil:
Itinatala ni Malou ang responsableng contact, susunod na hakbang at kailan muling magtatanong. Kung hindi pa kumpirmado ang lugar, sinasabi niya iyon sa grupo. Nakikinig siya sa kanilang pagpili at nakikipag-usap tungkol sa ibang angkop na plano kung kailangan.

Tinitiyak niya ang aktuwal na pagkakaroon ng suporta at pahintulot bago sabihing handa na. Ang personal na tanong pangkalusugan ay hiwalay na dinadala sa awtorisadong propesyonal ayon sa lokal na kaayusan. Hindi niya itinuturing na kumpirmasyon ang hula o pagiging kakilala.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Report confirmed and unconfirmed arrangements separately.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ibalita ang kumpirmado at hindi pa kumpirmado nang magkahiwalay.

read_sections.body_en:
The space and ten chairs for Saturday are still unconfirmed. What is Malou’s appropriate next step? Choose and explain your answer to the practice question.

Then form one question to confirm the local contact and approval. You may say it, write it or practise with a partner. What matters is explaining the role, making a clear request and verifying arrangements, rather than whether support is actually granted. The story is optional and is not required to complete the lesson.
read_sections.body_fil:
Hindi pa kumpirmado ang lugar at sampung upuan para sa Sabado. Ano ang angkop na susunod na hakbang ni Malou? Piliin at ipaliwanag ang sagot sa tanong sa pagsasanay.

Pagkatapos, bumuo ng isang tanong upang tiyakin ang lokal na contact at pahintulot. Maaari itong sabihin, isulat o subukan kasama ang kapareha. Ang mahalaga ay ang paliwanag ng papel, malinaw na kahilingan at pagtitiyak, hindi kung talagang naibigay ang suporta. Opsyonal ang kuwento at hindi kailangan upang matapos ang aralin.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Use the role, a clear request and verification to guide action.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Papel, malinaw na kahilingan at pagtitiyak ang batayan ng pagkilos.

private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin

Ilapat ang iisang layunin: ipaliwanag at ilapat ang mga katuwang sa barangay. Ipaliwanag ang papel at hangganan, bigyang-dahilan ang contact, bumuo ng malinaw na kahilingan at itanong ang lokal na kaayusan.

## [time-materials] Oras at Kagamitan

Ginawang hiwalay na facilitated estimate: 20 minuto: pambungad 2; mga papel 4; halimbawa ng kahilingan 4; koordinasyon at pagtitiyak 3; pares na pagsasanay 4; check at feedback 3. Ang kasalukuyang module ay may anim na 30-minutong bahagi, kabuuang 180. Ang pinagsamang barangay at city/municipal contacts ay 30 minuto. Para rito, pumili ng 10-minutong core dito (papel 3, halimbawa 4, check 3), at 20 para sa piniling city/municipal work; hindi pinagsasama ang buong hiwalay na pagsasanay. Nananatili sa protektadong 1.5.3 ang lumang 25-of-40 na salita; hindi ito binago o ipinapakitang naitama na. Ginawang pagtataya ng sariling pag-aaral: 8–11 minuto. Aktuwal na salaysay ng anim na screen: 235.88 segundo sa English at 275.96 segundo sa Filipino; maglaan ng 3–6 minuto para sa check at pagninilay. Dagdag pa ang opsyonal na kuwento o pag-ulit.

Kagamitan: anim na bilingual screen, kathang-isip na larawan, blankong request card, papel at panulat; opsyonal na headphones. Walang patient records.

## [prepare] Paghahanda

Basahin ang lahat ng screen at paliwanag. Tiyakin sa health team ang responsableng contact, reporting channel at pag-apruba. Markahan ang hindi alam; huwag mag-imbento. Maghanda ng malaking print at nakasulat na alternatibo. Kathang-isip ang larawan at kaso.

## [opening] Pambungad

Ipakilala ang napagkasunduang aktibidad ni Malou at hindi pa kumpirmadong lugar at sampung upuan. Itanong ang alam at dapat tiyakin. Pakinggan ang nais ng kalahok nang walang personal na health story.

## [steps] Mga Hakbang

1. Linawin ang kailangan at nais (2 minuto).
2. Ipaliwanag ang punong barangay, health kagawad at hangganan ng professional (4).
3. Imodelo ang kahilingan: layunin, oras, bilang, contact at tanong sa pahintulot (4).
4. Ihiwalay ang koordinasyon sa kumpirmadong pag-apruba at ibalita ang hindi alam (3).
5. Pares na kahilingan/observer; magpalitan (4).
6. Tatlong rationale at pagninilay (3). Dagdag at opsyonal ang kuwento; hindi kailangan para matapos.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang Sagot

Alam: napagkasunduang aktibidad, Sabado ng umaga, sampung upuan at lugar. Hindi pa alam: responsableng contact, kagamitan at pahintulot. Punong barangay: katuwang sa serbisyo at administratibong koordinasyon; health kagawad: pagtataguyod ng polisiya sa konseho, may lokal na tungkuling dapat tiyakin. Awtorisadong health professional ang sa teknikal/personal na gabay. Itanong ang responsable at pag-apruba; huwag mangako ng kagamitan.

## [misconception] Maling Akala

Hindi pahintulot ang pagiging kakilala. Hindi klinikal na awtoridad ang katungkulan. Hindi ibig sabihin ng pagtataguyod na isang tao ang makapagbibigay ng lahat ng suporta o bayad. Kahilingan ang paksa, hindi legal na tuntunin sa budget o honorarium.

## [practice] Pagsasanay

Kathang-isip na card A: sampung upuan at lugar sa Sabado; B: walang lugar, ibang petsa ang nais ng grupo. Ipaliwanag ang contact at hangganan, bumuo ng kahilingan at tanong na maglilinaw. Tukuyin ng observer ang alam at palagay, magbigay ng tiyak na mungkahi; magpalitan at umulit. Tanggap ang nakasulat na pagsasanay. Walang tunay na sagot ng opisyal o personal na datos na kailangan.

## [answer-key] Susi sa Sagot

Ang una ay angkop: responsableng contact at pagtitiyak ng proseso at suporta. Ang ikalawa ay hindi: hindi kumpirmasyon ang pagiging kakilala. Ang ikatlo ay hindi: hindi saklaw ng teknikal na health responsibility ang lahat ng kagamitan at pondo. Humingi ng dahilan at tanong na maglilinaw; hindi patunay ng observed competence ang click lamang.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Gamitin ang iisang objective_index 0 indicator. Kaya na: malayang naipapaliwanag ang papel at hangganan, dahilan, kahilingan at pagtitiyak. Kailangan practice: angkop ngunit kailangan ng untag. Hindi pa: matapos ang suporta, hindi pa tugma ang papel o may pangakong hindi kumpirmado; magmodelo at umulit. Hindi accent, confidence, impluwensiya o aktuwal na naibigay na suporta ang sinusukat.

## [support] Suporta

Cue card: kailangan / layunin / oras / papel / kahilingan / dapat tiyakin. Basahin o tanggapin ang dictation, sulat at nais na wika. Imodelo, magsanay na may untag, at ulitin na may mas kaunting suporta gamit ang katumbas na kathang-isip na aktibidad.

## [sources-review] Mga Sanggunian at Pagsusuri

Pagsusuri ng orihinal, 6 Oktubre 2026 (Asia/Manila): DOH Reference PDF15–16 / printed7–8; Facilitator PDF26–27 / printed19–20; deck PDF29–30; TESDA Revision01, 11 Enero2019, unit400311211, PDF11–12 / printed7–8 at84–85 / printed80–81. Sinusuportahan ang papel, pagtitiyak ng source at pinagsamang tatlong oras. Hindi makuha ang legal site; walang pahayag na napatunayang batas sa appropriation/honorarium o pangkalahatang lokal na proseso. Ginawa ang kaso, mga screen, kahilingan at oras. Draft ang bagong art/media; wala pang hiwalay na owner review, human listening o independent policy SME. May approved/draft inconsistency ang lumang practice-map; pinanatili ang historical bytes. Nananatili ang protektadong timing sa1.5.3 na nabanggit.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Apply the unchanged single objective: explain and apply barangay partners in a situation. Explain role and limit, justify a contact, make a clear support request and ask how to verify local arrangements.

## [time-materials] Time Materials

Authored standalone facilitated estimate: 20 minutes: opening 2; roles 4; request demonstration 4; coordination and verification 3; paired practice 4; check and feedback 3. The current shared module has six 30-minute segments, total 180. Its combined barangay and city/municipal contacts segment is 30 minutes. For that integrated segment select a shorter 10-minute core of this lesson (role map 3, worked request 4, check 3), reserving 20 for selected city/municipal work; full standalone exercises are not additive. Protected lesson1.5.3 still contains inherited 25-of-40 wording; it is not rewritten or claimed reconciled here. Authored independent estimate: 8–11 minutes. Actual six-screen narration is 235.88 seconds in English and 275.96 seconds in Filipino; allow 3–6 minutes for the check and reflection. Optional story or replay is additional.

Materials: six bilingual screens, fictional meeting art, blank request cards, paper and pens; optional headphones. Use no patient records.

## [prepare] Prepare

Read all screens and rationales. Verify local responsible contacts, reporting channels and approval procedures with the health team. Mark unknowns, not invented answers. Prepare large-print and written alternatives. Explain that the picture and case are fictional.

## [opening] Opening

Introduce Malou’s agreed activity and unconfirmed space and ten chairs. Ask which facts are known and which need checking. Invite participants’ preferences without asking for a personal health story.

## [steps] Steps

1. Clarify need and preferences (2 minutes).
2. Explain punong barangay and health kagawad roles and professional limits (4).
3. Model the Saturday request: purpose, timing, number, contact and approval question (4).
4. Distinguish coordination from confirmed approval and report unknowns accurately (3).
5. Paired request/observer practice, switch roles (4).
6. Check all three rationales and reflect (3). Optional story is additional and not needed for completion.

## [expected-answers] Expected Answers

Known: agreed activity, Saturday morning, ten chairs and a space needed. Unknown: responsible contact, availability and approval. Punong barangay: health-service partnership and administrative coordination; health kagawad: council health-policy advocacy, with additional locally assigned roles to verify. An authorized health professional handles technical/personal health guidance. A clear request asks who is responsible and what approval is needed; it does not promise resources.

## [misconception] Misconception

Knowing an official is not approval. Rank does not establish clinical authority. Advocacy does not mean one person can grant every resource or payment. This lesson teaches a bounded request, not legal budget or honorarium rules.

## [practice] Practice

Use fictional card A: ten chairs and space Saturday morning; B: space unavailable, group prefers another date. Learner explains the appropriate contact and limit, makes a request, and asks a verification question. Observer identifies a known fact and an assumption, offers one specific suggestion; switch and retry. Equivalent written practice is accepted. No actual official response or personal data is required.

## [answer-key] Answer Key

Choice 1 is appropriate: match the request to a responsible contact and verify process and availability. Choice 2 is inappropriate: personal acquaintance cannot confirm permission or chairs. Choice 3 is inappropriate: technical health responsibility does not automatically include all equipment and funding decisions. Ask for a reason and a local-verification question; a correct click alone is not observed competence.

## [observe] Observe

Use the one objective_index 0 indicator. Kaya na: independently explains roles and limits, justifies the contact, gives a clear request and verification question. Kailangan practice: sound direction needing a cue. Hindi pa: after support, still mismatches the role or promises unconfirmed resources; model and retry. Observe explanations, not accent, confidence, political influence or whether support is granted.

## [support] Support

Offer a cue card: need / purpose / time / role / request / what to confirm. Read aloud or accept dictation, writing and the learner’s preferred language. Model one request, practise with prompts, then repeat with less support using an equivalent fictional activity.

read_sections.body_en:
In this fictional learning situation, BHW Malou meets Aling Nena in a shaded barangay courtyard. Nena asks about a planned community health activity: “Where will it be held? I also want to ask a health professional whether it is suitable for me.”

Malou listens and asks which question Nena wants help with first. The venue question and the personal health question need different kinds of support. Nena's preferences matter; Malou does not decide what she needs without asking. Learners can finish this lesson in either reading or slide mode without watching the optional story.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa kathang-isip na sitwasyong ito, nakatagpo ni BHW Malou si Aling Nena sa malilim na bakuran ng barangay. Nagtanong si Nena tungkol sa nakaplanong gawaing pangkalusugan: “Saan po ito gaganapin? Gusto ko ring itanong sa health professional kung angkop ito para sa akin.”

Nakinig si Malou at nagtanong kung alin ang gustong unahing linawin ni Nena. Magkaibang suporta ang kailangan sa tanong tungkol sa lugar at sa personal na kalusugan. Mahalaga ang pagpili ni Nena; hindi hinuhulaan ni Malou ang kaniyang pangangailangan. Maaaring tapusin ang bahaging Basahin o Slides nang hindi pinapanood ang opsyonal na kuwento.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Listen to the resident and separate the questions before choosing support.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Makinig sa residente at ihiwalay ang mga tanong bago pumili ng suporta.

read_sections.body_en:
This lesson uses four relationships as an authored teaching organizer, not an official four-category chain of command.

Community: residents and families contribute their concerns, information and choices. Listen and clarify with them rather than treating them as passive recipients.

Designated midwife or Rural Health Unit health professional: seek authorized professional guidance for health questions, following locally confirmed arrangements. A BHW or peer does not replace professional assessment.

Barangay officials: ask the responsible local contact about administrative support, facilities or activity arrangements. Support depends on local roles and available resources; it is not guaranteed.

Fellow BHWs: share routine work experience, coordinate agreed tasks and help identify questions to clarify. Peer advice does not become clinical authority.
read_sections.body_fil:
Ginagamit sa araling ito ang apat na ugnayan bilang ginawang balangkas sa pagtuturo, hindi opisyal na apat na antas ng pamamahala.

Komunidad: ibinabahagi ng mga residente at pamilya ang kanilang alalahanin, impormasyon at pagpili. Makinig at maglinaw kasama nila; hindi lamang sila tagatanggap ng tulong.

Itinalagang midwife o health professional ng Rural Health Unit: humingi ng awtorisadong propesyonal na gabay sa tanong pangkalusugan, ayon sa lokal na kaayusang tiniyak. Hindi kapalit ng propesyonal na pagtatasa ang BHW o kapwa BHW.

Barangay officials: itanong sa responsableng lokal na contact ang suportang administratibo, pasilidad o kaayusan ng aktibidad. Nakasalalay ang suporta sa lokal na papel at magagamit na kagamitan; walang garantiya.

Kapwa BHW: magbahagi ng karanasan sa karaniwang gawain, mag-ugnay ng napagkasunduang mga tungkulin at tumulong tukuyin ang dapat linawin. Hindi nagiging klinikal na awtoridad ang payo ng kapwa BHW.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Each relationship has a purpose and a limit; verify the local roles.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: May layunin at hangganan ang bawat ugnayan; tiyakin ang lokal na papel.

read_sections.body_en:
Malou repeats what she heard: “You want to confirm the venue and speak with a health professional. Have I understood correctly?” Nena can correct that summary and explain what matters to her.

Malou knows that Nena has two questions. She still needs to confirm the venue, the locally designated professional contact, and Nena's preferred way to ask. Malou does not assume that Nena needs transport or has a particular illness. She asks, “What information would help you, and how would you prefer to receive it?” Use fictional details only during practice.
read_sections.body_fil:
Inulit ni Malou ang narinig: “Gusto ninyong tiyakin ang lugar at makausap ang health professional. Tama po ba ang pagkaunawa ko?” Maaaring itama ni Nena ang buod at sabihin kung ano ang mahalaga sa kaniya.

Alam: may dalawang tanong si Nena. Hindi pa alam: ang tiyak na lugar, ang lokal na itinalagang propesyonal na contact at ang paraang nais ni Nena sa pagtatanong. Hindi ipinapalagay ni Malou na kailangan ni Nena ng transportasyon o may partikular siyang sakit. Nagtanong siya: “Anong impormasyon ang makatutulong, at paano ninyo ito gustong matanggap?” Kathang-isip na detalye lamang ang gamitin sa pagsasanay.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Repeat, clarify and invite the resident to correct your understanding.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ulitin, linawin at hayaang itama ng residente ang iyong pagkaunawa.

read_sections.body_en:
For Nena's personal health question, Malou helps clarify the locally designated midwife or authorized health professional and how to contact them. She explains: “This question needs professional guidance; I should not answer it through a guess.” The exact local arrangement must be confirmed.

For the venue, Malou checks the activity's verified information and asks the responsible local coordinator if anything remains unclear. Ask a contact, “Is this within your role? If not, who is responsible?” Position or familiarity alone does not establish the right role. This is an organizational example, not medical triage or a universal referral sequence.
read_sections.body_fil:
Para sa personal na tanong pangkalusugan ni Nena, tumutulong si Malou na linawin ang lokal na itinalagang midwife o awtorisadong health professional at ang paraan ng pakikipag-ugnayan. Ipinaliwanag niya: “Kailangan dito ng propesyonal na gabay; hindi ako dapat sumagot sa pamamagitan ng hula.” Dapat tiyakin ang mismong lokal na kaayusan.

Para sa lugar, sinusuri ni Malou ang natiyak na impormasyon ng aktibidad at nagtatanong sa responsableng lokal na coordinator kung may malabo pa. Itanong sa contact: “Saklaw po ba ito ng inyong papel? Kung hindi, sino po ang responsable?” Hindi sapat ang posisyon o pagiging kakilala. Halimbawang pang-organisasyon ito, hindi medikal na triage o iisang proseso ng referral para sa lahat.

read_sections.heading_fil: Piliin ang contact ayon sa alalahanin
read_sections.takeaway_en: Choose by the concern and confirmed role, rather than rank alone.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Pumili ayon sa alalahanin at natiyak na papel, hindi sa posisyon lamang.

read_sections.body_en:
Malou keeps the questions separate while coordinating support. With Nena's agreement, she helps identify a suitable channel for the professional question. Separately, the responsible barangay contact may clarify the venue or a request for practical support. A fellow BHW can help Malou organize an agreed routine task and check what remains unclear.

Nena contributes her preferences throughout. Malou confirms what was actually agreed and what is still unknown. An official or peer cannot replace the health professional's assessment. No relationship guarantees transport, supplies, a response time or a successful outcome.
read_sections.body_fil:
Pinaghihiwalay ni Malou ang mga tanong habang pinag-uugnay ang suporta. Sa pagsang-ayon ni Nena, tumutulong siyang tukuyin ang angkop na paraan para sa propesyonal na tanong. Hiwalay dito, maaaring linawin ng responsableng barangay contact ang lugar o hiling na praktikal na suporta. Maaaring tulungan ng kapwa BHW si Malou na ayusin ang napagkasunduang karaniwang gawain at alamin ang malabo pa.

Patuloy na ibinabahagi ni Nena ang kaniyang pagpili. Tinitiyak ni Malou ang talagang napagkasunduan at ang hindi pa alam. Hindi kapalit ng health professional ang opisyal o kapwa BHW. Walang garantiya ng transportasyon, kagamitan, oras ng sagot o matagumpay na resulta.
read_sections.heading_fil: Mag-ugnay ng suporta nang may malinaw na papel
read_sections.takeaway_en: Coordinate distinct roles without promising resources or replacing assessment.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Pag-ugnayin ang magkakaibang papel nang walang pangako o kapalit na pagtatasa.

read_sections.body_en:
Try the application check below. In Nena's fictional situation, explain what each relationship can contribute and what it cannot decide. Give a reason for the contact you choose and one question you would use to verify that person's role.

For equivalent written or paired practice, make four cards: resident's concern and choice; professional question; administrative support request; peer task. Match each to an appropriate locally confirmed role, then explain the limits. Your partner can ask, “What do you still need to clarify?” Use invented details, receive feedback and try again. Judge the explanation, not the person's accent or personality.
read_sections.body_fil:
Subukan ang tanong sa ibaba. Sa kathang-isip na sitwasyon ni Nena, ipaliwanag ang maitutulong ng bawat ugnayan at ang hindi nito maaaring pagpasyahan. Magbigay ng dahilan sa piniling contact at isang tanong upang tiyakin ang papel niya.

Para sa katumbas na pasulat o magkapares na pagsasanay, gumawa ng apat na card: alalahanin at pagpili ng residente; propesyonal na tanong; hiling na suportang administratibo; gawain ng kapwa BHW. Itugma sa angkop na papel na tiniyak sa lokalidad, saka ipaliwanag ang hangganan. Maaaring itanong ng kapareha: “Ano pa ang kailangan mong linawin?” Gumamit ng kathang-isip na detalye, tumanggap ng puna at umulit. Paliwanag ang suriin, hindi punto ng pagsasalita o personalidad.

read_sections.takeaway_en: Explain the choice, verify the role and respect the resident’s preferences.

Try the application check below. In Nena's fictional situation, explain what each relationship can contribute and what it cannot decide. Give a reason for the contact you choose and one question you would use to verify that person's role.

For equivalent written or paired practice, make four cards: resident's concern and choice; professional question; administrative support request; peer task. Match each to an appropriate locally confirmed role, then explain the limits. Your partner can ask, “What do you still need to clarify?” Use invented details, receive feedback and try again. Judge the explanation, not the person's accent or personality.

Subukan ang tanong sa ibaba. Sa kathang-isip na sitwasyon ni Nena, ipaliwanag ang maitutulong ng bawat ugnayan at ang hindi nito maaaring pagpasyahan. Magbigay ng dahilan sa piniling contact at isang tanong upang tiyakin ang papel niya.

private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin

Ilapat ang iisang layunin ng aralin, objective_index 0: ipaliwanag at gamitin ang apat na ugnayan sa kathang-isip na sitwasyon. Ipaliwanag ang layunin at hangganan ng bawat isa, pumili ng angkop na contact at dahilan, magtanong upang tiyakin ang papel at kilalanin ang nais ng residente. Pambungad na balangkas ito; hindi kapalit ng susunod na aralin tungkol sa stakeholders, teamwork, self-management o pagpili ng contact.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

Ginawang bahagi ng harapang sesyon: 30 minuto. Pambungad 4; apat na papel 6; halimbawa ng pakikinig 5; pagpapakita ng pagpili ng contact 6; magkapares na pagsasanay 5; application check, puna at pagninilay 4. Kabuuan 30. Kasama sa 5 minuto ng pagsasanay ang opsyonal na card exercise; hindi ito dagdag na sapilitang oras. Ginawang hati ng buong module: 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 = 180 minuto, kasama ang opsyonal na gawain. Itinama sa 30 ang dalawang dating 40-minutong bahagi sa shared guide; hindi binago ang nilalaman o gabay ng sibling lessons. Tatlong tig-isang-oras na outcome ang nasa TESDA para sa pinagsamang competency, hindi sapilitang 30 minuto para sa 1.5.1. Ginawang pagtataya ng sariling pag-aaral: 10–13 minuto. Aktuwal na salaysay ng anim na screen: 350.85 segundo sa English at 383.98 segundo sa Filipino; maglaan ng 3–6 minuto para sa check at pagninilay. Dagdag pa ang opsyonal na kuwento o pag-ulit.

Kagamitan: anim na bilingual screen, courtyard art ni Malou, apat na malalaking blangkong card na may label, papel at panulat; opsyonal na speaker o headphones. Kathang-isip na impormasyon lamang.

## [prepare] Paghahanda

Basahin ang anim na screen, lahat ng paliwanag sa pagpipilian at source audit sa dalawang wika. Tiyakin sa health team ang lokal na propesyonal, administratibo at peer roles at madaling maabot na paraan ng pakikipag-ugnayan; markahan ang hindi pa alam. Kathang-isip ang larawan at hindi patunay ng lokal na proseso. Ihanda ang cards at katumbas na pasulat na gawain. Huwag humingi ng totoong kuwento ng sakit, patient record, numero ng telepono o personal na dokumento.

## [opening] Pambungad

Sa 4 minuto, ipakilala sina Malou at Nena sa kathang-isip na bakuran. May tanong si Nena sa lugar at personal na kalusugan. Itanong ang alam ni Malou at ang dapat munang linawin. Tanggapin ang ibang pagkakasunod kung nagtatanong ang learner kay Nena sa halip na magpasya para sa kaniya. Huwag itong gawing diagnosis, pagtakda ng tagal ng sintomas o medikal na triage.

## [steps] Mga hakbang

1. Pambungad: ihiwalay ang dalawang tanong at itanong ang nais ni Nena (4 minuto).
2. Ipaliwanag ang apat na card: isang layunin at hangganan sa bawat ugnayan (6).
3. Ipakita ang pag-uulit ng sinabi ni Nena, pagtatanong kung tama ang buod at paghihiwalay ng alam sa hula (5).
4. Ihambing ang gabay pangkalusugan at koordinasyon sa lugar. Ipakita ang “Saklaw po ba ito ng inyong papel? Kung hindi, sino po ang responsable?” Tiyakin ang lokal na kaayusan; huwag gumawa ng iisang chain of command (6).
5. Magkapares na apat na card; magpalitan bilang learner at observer. Katumbas ang pasulat na pagsasanay (5).
6. Application check, lahat ng tatlong paliwanag, puna at tanong na maglilinaw ng papel (4). Opsyonal ang kuwento at hindi kailangan sa online completion.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Komunidad: ibinabahagi ni Nena ang alalahanin, impormasyon at gustong paraan. Propesyonal: awtorisadong lokal na health professional ang sasagot sa personal na tanong pangkalusugan; hindi ito tinatasa ni Malou sa pamamagitan ng hula. Opisyal: maaaring linawin ng responsableng administratibong contact ang lugar o hiling na praktikal na suporta, ayon sa lokal na kaayusan at magagamit na kagamitan. Kapwa BHW: karanasan sa karaniwang gawain at napagkasunduang pagtutulungan, hindi klinikal na awtoridad. Alam: dalawang tanong. Hindi pa alam: tiyak na lugar, propesyonal na contact at gustong paraan ni Nena. Tanggapin ang katumbas na paliwanag na may parehong hangganan.

## [misconception] Karaniwang maling akala

“Ang pinakamataas na posisyon ang makapagpapasya sa lahat.” Dapat tugma ang papel at awtoridad sa alalahanin; hindi sapat ang posisyon para sa klinikal na awtoridad. “Kapalit ng pagtatasa ang karanasan ng kapwa BHW.” Iba ang layunin ng peer support. “Tagatanggap lamang ng utos ang residente.” Maaaring maglinaw, magtama at pumili si Nena. Itama ang paliwanag nang hindi hinuhusgahan ang personalidad o punto ng pagsasalita.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Mga kathang-isip na card: A, gustong tiyakin ni Nena ang lugar; B, gusto niyang itanong sa propesyonal kung angkop ang aktibidad; C, kailangan ni Malou ng tulong sa pag-aayos ng napagkasunduang karaniwang gawain; D, itinatama ng residente ang buod ni Malou at mas nais ang pasulat na impormasyon. Magkapares, ipaliwanag ang angkop na ugnayan, hangganan, dahilan at isang tanong na magtityak ng papel sa bawat card. Itala ng observer ang aktuwal na sinabi, magbigay ng isang tiyak na mungkahi at magpaulit. Hindi kailangang gamitin ang apat na ugnayan sa bawat totoong gawain. Katumbas ang pasulat na pagtutugma ng cards na may dahilan; walang pribadong impormasyon.

## [answer-key] Susi sa self-check

Pareho ang tatlong pagpipilian at buong puna sa huling Read/Slide check. Una: angkop, nakikinig kay Nena at tinitiyak ang magkahiwalay na papel para sa kalusugan at lugar. Ikalawa: hindi angkop, hindi nagbibigay ng klinikal na awtoridad ang pinakamataas na posisyon. Ikatlo: hindi angkop, hindi kapalit ng awtorisadong pagtatasa ang karanasan ng kapwa BHW. Ipapaliwanag din ang komunidad at kapwa BHW, saka magpabigay ng tanong na maglilinaw ng papel. Hindi sapat na patunay ng kasanayan ang tamang online choice.

## [observe] Ano ang oobserbahan

Gamitin ang iisang objective_index 0 indicator. Kaya na: walang untag na naipapaliwanag ang apat na layunin at hangganan, pumipili ayon sa alalahanin, nagbibigay ng dahilan at tanong na magtityak, at kinikilala ang nais ni Nena. Kailangan practice: angkop ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng gabay sa isang papel, hangganan o tanong. Hindi pa: hindi pa angkop matapos ang suporta, kabilang ang pagpapalit ng posisyon o karanasan sa propesyonal na pagtatasa. Magmodelo at umulit. Paliwanag at paglilinaw ang obserbahan, hindi punto, kumpiyansa, hitsura, personalidad o tagumpay ng hiling na serbisyo.

## [support] Kung kailangan ng suporta

Magbigay ng cue card: alalahanin / papel / dahilan / hangganan / tanong. Basahin nang malakas, gumamit ng malalaking letra, hayaang magdikta o sumulat at itanong ang nais na wika. Maaaring magpakita muna ng isang card ang supportive partner. Hayaang mag-obserba muna, magsanay na may gabay, saka umulit na mas kaunti ang tulong. Muling obserbahan gamit ang katumbas na kathang-isip na halimbawa sa lugar o karaniwang gawain; walang personal na kuwento ng kalusugan na kailangan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Na-audit noong 6 Oktubre2026: orihinal na DOH Reference Manual PDF15–17 / nakalimbag7–9, Facilitator Manual PDF26–27 / nakalimbag19–20, Day1 deck PDF27–28 (walang nakalimbag na slide number), at opisyal na TESDA BHS NCII Revision01, promulgated11 Enero2019, unit400311211, PDF11–12 / nakalimbag7–8 at PDF84–85 / nakalimbag80–81. Sinusuportahan ng sources ang papel, komunikasyon at team outcomes. Ang mismong apat na ugnayan ay galing sa ginawang balangkas sa repository commit d424bde, hindi direktang opisyal na taxonomy. Sariling halimbawa sina Malou at Nena, ang tanong, pagsasanay at hati ng oras. Salungat ang approved flag ng lumang practice-map sa draft caption at provenance; bagong draft art ang gamit dito, habang pinananatili ang lumang public bytes. Hindi pa natiyak ang kasalukuyang target LGU process, hiwalay na policy SME review, human listening o owner approval. Natiyak ang bagong download ng opisyal na PDF; hindi patunay na walang mas bagong revision.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Apply the single lesson objective, objective_index 0: explain and apply four working relationships in a fictional situation. Learners explain each purpose and limit, choose an appropriate contact with a reason, ask a role-verification question and recognize the resident's preferences. This introductory organizer does not replace the later lessons about stakeholders, teamwork, self-management or contact decisions.

## [time-materials] Time Materials

Authored facilitated share: 30 minutes. Opening 4; four-role organizer 6; listening example 5; contact demonstration 6; paired practice 5; application check, feedback and reflection 4. Total 30. The optional paired/card exercise is inside the 5-minute practice share, not additional compulsory time. Whole-module authored split: 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 = 180 minutes, including optional exercises. The shared guide's two former 40-minute shares are corrected to 30; no sibling lesson content or guides are rewritten. TESDA specifies three one-hour outcomes for the combined competency, not a mandatory 30-minute 1.5.1 lesson. Authored independent estimate: 10–13 minutes. Actual six-screen narration is 350.85 seconds in English and 383.98 seconds in Filipino; allow 3–6 minutes for the check and reflection. Optional story or replay is additional.

Materials: six bilingual screens, Malou's courtyard art, four large labeled blank cards, paper and pens; optional speaker/headphones. Use fictional information only.

## [prepare] Prepare

Read all six screens, every check rationale and the source audit in both languages. Confirm local professional, administrative and peer roles and accessible contact channels with the health team; mark unknowns. The illustration is fictional and proves no local procedure. Prepare cards and a written alternative. Do not request a real health story, patient record, phone number or personal document.

## [opening] Opening

For 4 minutes, introduce fictional Malou and Nena in the courtyard. Nena asks about the venue and a personal health question. Ask what Malou knows and should clarify first. Accept different priorities if the learner asks Nena rather than deciding for her. Do not turn this into diagnosis, symptom thresholds or medical triage.

## [steps] Steps

1. Opening: separate the two questions and invite Nena's preference (4 minutes).
2. Explain the four-card organizer, one purpose and boundary per relationship (6).
3. Model repeating Nena's words, asking whether the summary is right, and separating facts from assumptions (5).
4. Compare health guidance and venue coordination. Demonstrate “Is this within your role? If not, who is responsible?” Confirm local arrangements; do not invent a chain of command (6).
5. Paired four-card practice, switching learner and observer; written practice is equivalent (5).
6. Application check, all three rationales, feedback and a role-verification reflection (4). Story playback is optional and unnecessary for online completion.

## [expected-answers] Expected Answers

Community: Nena shares her concern, information and preferred channel. Professional: an authorized local health professional addresses the personal health question; Malou does not assess it by guessing. Officials: responsible administrative contacts may clarify the venue or requested practical support, subject to local arrangements and resources. Peers: share routine task experience and coordinate agreed work; they do not provide clinical authority. Known: two questions. Unknown: confirmed venue, professional contact and Nena's preferred channel. Accept equivalent explanations that preserve these limits.

## [misconception] Misconception

“The highest-ranking person can decide every concern.” Role and authority must fit the concern; rank alone does not establish clinical authority. “A fellow BHW's experience replaces assessment.” Peer support has a different purpose. “The resident simply receives instructions.” Nena can clarify, correct and choose. Correct the explanation without judging the learner's personality or accent.

## [practice] Practice

Use fictional cards A: Nena wants the venue confirmed; B: Nena wants a professional answer about suitability; C: Malou needs help organizing an agreed routine task; D: a resident corrects Malou's summary and prefers written information. In pairs, explain the appropriate relationship, its boundary, a reason and one role-confirmation question for each card. The observer records what was said, gives one specific suggestion and invites re-practice. Do not require all four relationships in every real task. Written four-card matching with reasons is equivalent; use no private information.

## [answer-key] Answer Key

The final Read/Slide check has the same three choices and full feedback. First is appropriate: listen to Nena and confirm separate professional and venue roles. Second is inappropriate: highest rank does not confer clinical authority. Third is inappropriate: peer experience cannot replace authorized assessment. Ask the learner to explain the role of the community and fellow BHW too, then provide a role-verification question. A correct online choice alone is not proof of observed skill.

## [observe] Observe

Use the one objective_index 0 indicator. Kaya na: without prompting, explains all four purposes and limits, chooses by the concern, gives a reason and verification question, and recognizes Nena's preferences. Kailangan practice: sound direction but a cue is needed for one role, limit or question. Hindi pa: explanation remains inappropriate after support, including substituting rank or peer experience for professional assessment. Model and repeat. Observe the explanation and clarification, not accent, confidence, appearance, personality or success of a service request.

## [support] Support

Offer a cue card: concern / role / reason / limit / question. Read aloud, provide large print, let a learner dictate or write, and ask the preferred language. A supportive partner can first model one card. Let the learner observe a round, then practise with prompts and repeat with less support. Re-observe with an equivalent fictional venue or routine-task example; require no personal health disclosure.

## [sources-review] Sources Review

Audited 6 October2026: original DOH Reference Manual PDF15–17 / printed7–9, Facilitator Manual PDF26–27 / printed19–20, Day1 deck PDF27–28 (no printed slide number), and official TESDA BHS NCII Revision01, promulgated11 January2019, unit400311211, PDF11–12 / printed7–8 and PDF84–85 / printed80–81. Sources support roles, communication and team outcomes. The exact four-relationship grouping traces to authored repository commit d424bde, not a verbatim official taxonomy. Malou, Nena's neutral example, questions, practice and timing split are authored. The inherited practice-map approved flag conflicted with draft captions/provenance; new draft art replaces it in this target, while its old public bytes remain preserved. No current target LGU procedure, independent policy SME review, human listening or owner approval is claimed. Fresh official PDF bytes were verified; absence of a later revision has not been established.

objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: following up constructively.

read_sections.body_en:
In this fictional continuation, Demi is waiting for news about her accreditation application. She knows she provided an application. She has not confirmed whether it was received and complete, who is handling it, or whether a decision exists. She does not know the cause of the delay.

At the planning corner, a colleague helps her prepare a question. Fear, cost or difficulty travelling and communicating may be barriers. She can seek support and choose an appropriate way to ask. The story video is optional; you can complete Read or Slides without watching it.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa kathang-isip na pagpapatuloy, naghihintay si Demi ng balita tungkol sa kaniyang aplikasyon sa akreditasyon. Alam niyang nagbigay siya ng aplikasyon. Hindi pa niya nakukumpirma kung natanggap at kumpleto ito, sino ang humahawak, o kung may pasya na. Hindi niya alam ang dahilan ng pagkaantala.

Sa planning corner, tinutulungan siya ng kasamahan na ihanda ang tanong. Maaaring may pangamba, gastos o hirap sa pagpunta at pakikipag-usap. Puwedeng humingi ng suporta at pumili ng angkop na paraan. Opsyonal ang kuwentong video; maaaring tapusin ang Read o Slides nang hindi ito pinapanood.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Separate known facts from what is unconfirmed.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ihiwalay ang alam sa hindi pa nakukumpirma.

read_sections.body_en:
If helpful, pause and breathe before asking. Follow-up can be respectful and firm even when you feel worried or frustrated. You do not need to hide your feelings to form a clear question.

With a locally confirmed contact, Demi might say: “Good day. I would like to ask about my accreditation application. Has it been received, and is anything still unclear when checking completeness? Who is the appropriate person to ask, and what is the next step?” This is a fictional example. Confirm the office and channel with the local health team; do not assume every staff member has the same responsibility.
read_sections.body_fil:
Kung makatutulong, huminto sandali at huminga bago magtanong. Maaaring magalang at matatag ang follow-up kahit nakakaramdam ng pagkabahala o inis. Hindi kailangang itago ang damdamin upang makabuo ng malinaw na tanong.

Sa locally confirmed na contact, maaaring sabihin ni Demi: “Magandang araw po. Nais ko pong magtanong tungkol sa aplikasyon ko sa akreditasyon. Natanggap na po ba ito, at may kailangan pa bang linawin upang matiyak kung kumpleto? Sino po ang tamang kausap, at ano ang susunod na hakbang?” Kathang-isip na halimbawa ito. Tiyakin ang tamang opisina at channel sa lokal na health team; huwag ipagpalagay na lahat ng staff ay may parehong tungkulin.
read_sections.heading_en: Pause and ask a specific question
read_sections.heading_fil: Huminto sandali at magtanong nang tiyak
read_sections.takeaway_en: State your purpose, ask about status and clarify the next step.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Sabihin ang pakay, itanong ang status at linawin ang susunod na hakbang.

read_sections.body_en:
Card A: “When will this happen?” It expresses concern but does not identify the application or information requested. Help make the purpose specific. Card B: “About my fictional accreditation application: has it been received, and how can I verify the status and next step?” It names the purpose and asks for unconfirmed information.

Card C: “A document must be lost; I will submit everything again.” It guesses the cause and requirement. Waiting does not prove loss. First ask whether an item needs verification, exactly which item and how to provide it safely through the appropriate channel. Practice uses no real documents.
read_sections.body_fil:
Card A: “Kailan pa ba ito?” May pag-aalala, ngunit hindi malinaw kung aling aplikasyon o impormasyon ang hinihingi. Tulungang tukuyin ang pakay. Card B: “Tungkol po sa kathang-isip na aplikasyon ko sa akreditasyon: natanggap na po ba ito, at paano ko matitiyak ang status at susunod na hakbang?” Tiyak ang pakay at humihingi ng impormasyong hindi pa nakukumpirma.

Card C: “Tiyak na may nawawalang dokumento; ipapasa ko na lang muli lahat.” Hula ang sanhi at requirement. Hindi patunay ng pagkawala ang paghihintay. Itanong muna kung may item na kailangang tiyakin, ano mismo iyon at paano ligtas na magbigay sa tamang channel. Walang totoong dokumentong gagamitin sa pagsasanay.
read_sections.heading_fil: Aling card ang may malinaw na tanong?
read_sections.takeaway_en: Card B asks; it does not turn a guess into a fact.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Card B ay nagtatanong; hindi nito ginagawang fact ang hula.

read_sections.body_en:
Before: Demi thinks, “Perhaps it is approved because it has been a long time.” She has not confirmed this. After: in the fictional conversation, the appropriate contact says the application is still being reviewed and no date can be given. This is the example’s response, not a national procedure or timetable.

Demi repeats: “I understand it is still under review and there is no date yet. Is that right? Is there anything I should do now? Through which channel and with whom can I ask for the next update?” She listens to clarification and names any remaining uncertainty. The response establishes neither approval nor a missing document. Constructive follow-up does not guarantee an answer, accreditation, a benefit or an appointment.
read_sections.body_fil:
Bago: iniisip ni Demi na “baka aprubado na dahil matagal na.” Hindi niya pa ito nakukumpirma. Pagkatapos: sa kathang-isip na usapan, sinabi ng tamang contact na sinusuri pa ang aplikasyon at wala pang petsang maibibigay. Ito ang sagot sa halimbawa, hindi pambansang proseso o takdang oras.

Ulit ni Demi: “Ang pagkaunawa ko po ay sinusuri pa at wala pang petsa. Tama po ba? May kailangan po ba akong gawin ngayon? Saang channel at kanino ko maaaring itanong ang susunod na update?” Pinakikinggan niya ang paglilinaw at sinasabi kung may hindi pa malinaw. Walang natiyak na approval o kulang na dokumento sa sagot. Ang maayos na follow-up ay hindi garantiya ng sagot, akreditasyon, benepisyo o appointment.

read_sections.body_en:
If there is no date, ask how to agree on an appropriate next contact. If an item needs verification, clarify the exact item and proper method before acting. If responsibility is unclear, ask the local health team to help identify the contact. There is no single prescribed interval for everyone.

In a practice note, write only the fictional purpose, confirmed response, remaining question and agreed next contact or channel. Use no private details or patient record. A support person, written question or another accessible method may help. Reflect on whether the question was clear and try again after feedback. A confirmed next question is useful even without an outcome.
read_sections.body_fil:
Kung walang petsa, itanong kung paano magkakasundo sa angkop na susunod na contact. Kung may item na kailangang tiyakin, linawin ang eksaktong item at tamang paraan bago kumilos. Kung hindi malinaw kung sino ang responsable, humingi ng tulong sa lokal na health team upang matukoy ang contact. Walang iisang itinakdang pagitan para sa lahat.

Sa practice note, isulat lamang ang kathang-isip na pakay, nakumpirmang sagot, natitirang tanong at napagkasunduang susunod na contact o channel. Walang pribadong detalye o patient record. Maaaring humingi ng katuwang, written question o iba pang accessible na paraan. Balikan kung naging malinaw ang tanong at subukang muli matapos ang feedback. Kapaki-pakinabang ang nakumpirmang susunod na tanong kahit wala pang resulta.

In the fictional case, Demi provided an application but receipt, status and the cause of delay are unconfirmed. What is a constructive follow-up?

Choose the response that separates facts from guesses, asks a specific question through a locally confirmed contact, and plans to clarify the answer and next step. Explain why the other two options are insufficient. This is an online self-check; observed practice and administrative outcomes are separate.

Sa kathang-isip na kaso, nagbigay si Demi ng aplikasyon ngunit hindi pa nakukumpirma ang pagtanggap, status o sanhi ng pagkaantala. Ano ang maayos na follow-up?

slides.narration_en:
In this fictional continuation, Demi is waiting for news about her accreditation application. She knows she provided an application. She has not confirmed whether it was received and complete, who is handling it, or whether a decision exists. She does not know the cause of the delay.

At the planning corner, a colleague helps her prepare a question. Fear, cost or difficulty travelling and communicating may be barriers. She can seek support and choose an appropriate way to ask. The story video is optional; you can complete Read or Slides without watching it.
slides.narration_fil:
Sa kathang-isip na pagpapatuloy, naghihintay si Demi ng balita tungkol sa kaniyang aplikasyon sa akreditasyon. Alam niyang nagbigay siya ng aplikasyon. Hindi pa niya nakukumpirma kung natanggap at kumpleto ito, sino ang humahawak, o kung may pasya na. Hindi niya alam ang dahilan ng pagkaantala.

Sa planning corner, tinutulungan siya ng kasamahan na ihanda ang tanong. Maaaring may pangamba, gastos o hirap sa pagpunta at pakikipag-usap. Puwedeng humingi ng suporta at pumili ng angkop na paraan. Opsyonal ang kuwentong video; maaaring tapusin ang Read o Slides nang hindi ito pinapanood.

slides.heading_fil: Huminto sandali at magtanong nang tiyak
slides.narration_en:
If helpful, pause and breathe before asking. Follow-up can be respectful and firm even when you feel worried or frustrated. You do not need to hide your feelings to form a clear question.

With a locally confirmed contact, Demi might say: “Good day. I would like to ask about my accreditation application. Has it been received, and is anything still unclear when checking completeness? Who is the appropriate person to ask, and what is the next step?” This is a fictional example. Confirm the office and channel with the local health team; do not assume every staff member has the same responsibility.
slides.narration_fil:
Kung makatutulong, huminto sandali at huminga bago magtanong. Maaaring magalang at matatag ang follow-up kahit nakakaramdam ng pagkabahala o inis. Hindi kailangang itago ang damdamin upang makabuo ng malinaw na tanong.

Sa locally confirmed na contact, maaaring sabihin ni Demi: “Magandang araw po. Nais ko pong magtanong tungkol sa aplikasyon ko sa akreditasyon. Natanggap na po ba ito, at may kailangan pa bang linawin upang matiyak kung kumpleto? Sino po ang tamang kausap, at ano ang susunod na hakbang?” Kathang-isip na halimbawa ito. Tiyakin ang tamang opisina at channel sa lokal na health team; huwag ipagpalagay na lahat ng staff ay may parehong tungkulin.

slides.heading_fil: Aling card ang may malinaw na tanong?
slides.narration_en:
Card A: “When will this happen?” It expresses concern but does not identify the application or information requested. Help make the purpose specific. Card B: “About my fictional accreditation application: has it been received, and how can I verify the status and next step?” It names the purpose and asks for unconfirmed information.

Card C: “A document must be lost; I will submit everything again.” It guesses the cause and requirement. Waiting does not prove loss. First ask whether an item needs verification, exactly which item and how to provide it safely through the appropriate channel. Practice uses no real documents.
slides.narration_fil:
Card A: “Kailan pa ba ito?” May pag-aalala, ngunit hindi malinaw kung aling aplikasyon o impormasyon ang hinihingi. Tulungang tukuyin ang pakay. Card B: “Tungkol po sa kathang-isip na aplikasyon ko sa akreditasyon: natanggap na po ba ito, at paano ko matitiyak ang status at susunod na hakbang?” Tiyak ang pakay at humihingi ng impormasyong hindi pa nakukumpirma.

Card C: “Tiyak na may nawawalang dokumento; ipapasa ko na lang muli lahat.” Hula ang sanhi at requirement. Hindi patunay ng pagkawala ang paghihintay. Itanong muna kung may item na kailangang tiyakin, ano mismo iyon at paano ligtas na magbigay sa tamang channel. Walang totoong dokumentong gagamitin sa pagsasanay.

Before: Demi thinks, “Perhaps it is approved because it has been a long time.” She has not confirmed this. After: in the fictional conversation, the appropriate contact says the application is still being reviewed and no date can be given. This is the example’s response, not a national procedure or timetable.

Demi repeats: “I understand it is still under review and there is no date yet. Is that right? Is there anything I should do now? Through which channel and with whom can I ask for the next update?” She listens to clarification and names any remaining uncertainty. The response establishes neither approval nor a missing document. Constructive follow-up does not guarantee an answer, accreditation, a benefit or an appointment.

private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin

Mailapat ang iisang objective, index 0: ipaliwanag at isagawa ang maayos na follow-up. Sa fictional practice, ihiwalay ang alam sa hula, magtanong nang tiyak sa tamang contact, makinig at linawin, at pumili ng angkop na susunod na hakbang. Ang self-management at reflection ay suporta sa kilos, hindi paghatol sa personalidad.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

45 minutong authored facilitated share: pambungad 5; question demonstration 5; Card A/B/C analysis 5; rotating role-play 15; observer feedback at re-practice 10; application check at reflection 5. Kabuuan 45. Ang optional form-and-follow-up activity na 30 minuto ay nasa loob ng huling 30 minuto, hindi dagdag na compulsory time. Panatilihin ang module 180 minuto: 15 + apat na 30 + 45. Hindi hiwalay na TESDA minimum para sa follow-up ang 45 minuto. Authored self-study estimate: 10–12 minuto batay sa anim na screen, 324.31 segundo ng English o 347.27 segundo ng Filipino encoded narration, at humigit-kumulang 4–6 minuto para sa pagbasa/check/reflection; dagdag ang optional stories at replay. Gumamit ng anim na screen, fictional cards, blangkong notebook at panulat; walang pribadong dokumento.

## [prepare] Maghanda

Basahin ang bilingual Read/Slides at source audit. Tiyakin sa lokal na health team ang contact at accessible na channel; markahan ang hindi alam, huwag mag-imbento ng opisina o deadline. Ihanda ang tatlong learner card at tatlong staff card sa practice. Walang compelled disclosure ng accreditation, benepisyo o personal distress. Adapted follow-up-only ang form activity sa package: verified ang CSC website reference sa CS Form 101-H revised Dec.2011 ngunit hindi pa natiyak ang download bytes; walang official form demo o submission dito.

## [opening] Pambungad

Sa 5 minuto, ipakita ang kathang-isip na Demi na nagbigay ng aplikasyon ngunit walang nakumpirmang update. Itanong: “Ano ang alam? Ano ang hindi pa tiyak?” Tanggapin ang pag-aalala nang hindi sinisisi ang pananahimik. Hindi kailangang magbahagi ng sariling pagkaantala. Maaaring sumagot sa card, sariling wika o kasama ang katuwang.

## [steps] Mga hakbang

1. Pambungad at known/unknown (5 minuto).
2. I-model ang pause kung helpful, pakay at tanong sa section-6 (5). Ipakita ang magalang at matatag na paraan, walang guarantee.
3. Ihambing ang Cards A/B/C (5).
4. Tatlong role-play rounds: learner, contact at observer; 5 minuto bawat round kasama ang maikling paglilinaw (15).
5. Observer feedback, reflection at ulitin ang tanong sa bagong staff card (10).
6. Application check, lahat ng rationale at isang realistic next-contact note (5). Hindi kailangan ang optional video sa online completion.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Alam: nagbigay ng fictional application. Hindi alam: receipt, completeness, status, sanhi, responsable at petsa. Card A: tulungang linawin ang application at pakay; hindi masamang tao ang nagtatanong nang malabo. Card B: may tiyak na pakay at verification question. Card C: hula ang lost document at requirement; itanong muna kung may dapat tiyakin. Kapag “nakakainis,” tanggapin ang damdamin at tulungang bumuo ng tanong. Kapag hindi alam ang contact, itala bilang unknown at kumpirmahin sa health team; huwag imbentuhin.

## [misconception] Karaniwang maling akala

“Kapag matagal, aprubado na.” Hindi patunay ng pasya ang tagal. “Tiyak na nawala ang dokumento.” Hindi alam ang sanhi hangga’t hindi nakumpirma. “Dapat walang emosyon para pumasa.” Hindi accent, damdamin, tahimik na personalidad o assertiveness ang skill score. Ang obserbasyon ay specific question, facts/unknowns, clarification at bounded next step. Hindi garantiya ng sagot o benepisyo ang calmness.

## [practice] Pagsasanay

Learner cards: A malabong tanong; B specific verification question; C hula sa lost document (buong teksto nasa screen 3). Staff card 1: “Sinusuri pa. Wala pang petsa.” Staff card 2: “May item na kailangang i-verify; linawin natin kung ano at paano.” Staff card 3: “Hindi ko matiyak kung sino ang responsable.” Mga fictional response lang ito. Magpalitan ng role sa tatlong round. Learner: pakay, known/unknown, specific question, ulitin ang sagot, linawin ang next contact. Observer: itala ang aktuwal na narinig at isang suggestion. Re-practice matapos ang feedback. Worksheet: fictional pakay / confirmed response / natitirang tanong / agreed next contact. Walang real ID o dokumento.

## [answer-key] Susi sa self-check

Iisang three-choice check sa huling Read at Slide screen. Una: tama, kinukumpirma ang receipt/status, nakikinig at nililinaw ang next step sa tamang contact. Ikalawa: walang batayan ang automatic approval dahil matagal nang naghihintay. Ikatlo: hula ang lost document at requirement; hindi muna dapat ipasa muli lahat. Ipaliwanag ang bawat dahilan; tanggapin ang katumbas na sariling salita. Hiwalay ang online correct answer sa observed skill.

## [observe] Dapat obserbahan

Gamitin ang isang objective_index 0 indicator. Kaya na: walang prompt na naihihiwalay ang facts/unknowns, may specific question, nauulit/nalilinaw ang staff response at bounded next step sa dalawang staff card. Kailangan practice: nasa tamang direksiyon ngunit may prompt sa isa sa mga kilos. Hindi pa: patuloy na hula ang sanhi/approval o walang specific question/clarification pagkatapos ng suporta; magmodelo at ulitin. Hindi nangangahulugan ng incompetence ang accent, kaba, galit o paggamit ng written question. Walang score sa administrative result.

## [support] Kung kailangan ng suporta

Magbigay ng four-part cue card: alam at unknown / tanong / naunawaan at paglilinaw / next contact. Puwedeng basahin, isulat, pakinggan o idikta ang tanong. Pair sa supportive partner, hayaang maging observer muna, at i-model ang staff card 1. Humingi ng preferred language at accessible method. Bawasan ang prompt sa ikalawang practice at muling obserbahan. Huwag piliting magkuwento ng totoong pagkaantala o personal distress.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at review notes

Audit 5 Oktubre 2026: original DOH Facilitator Guide PDF23/printed16 (126-page file, exact SHA sa audit); TESDA BHS NCII Revision01, unit400311213 PDF19–20/printed15–16 at PDF86–87/printed82–83. Suportado ang emotion management, reflective practice, communication/self-regulation at tatlong oras para sa buong competency. Authored application ang Demi, lahat ng cards, specific questions, contact planning at 45-minute split; hindi statutory interval o empirical promise. Original Day1 PDF25 walang printed slide number: optional CSC form activity. Website reference lang ang current CSC form evidence; download bytes hindi verified, kaya adapted/omitted ang demo. Walang verified target LGU procedure, full national IRR/amendment history, independent policy SME approval o human listening. New lesson/media draft para sa separate owner review.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Apply the one objective, index 0: explain and demonstrate constructive follow-up. In fictional practice, separate facts from guesses, ask a specific question through the appropriate contact, listen and clarify, and choose a bounded next step. Self-management and reflection support these actions; they are not personality judgments.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

Authored facilitated share, 45 minutes: opening 5; question demonstration 5; Card A/B/C analysis 5; rotating role-play 15; observer feedback and re-practice 10; application check and reflection 5. Total 45. The optional 30-minute form-and-follow-up activity fits inside the final 30 minutes; it adds no compulsory time. Retain the module’s 180 minutes: 15 + four 30-minute parts + 45. The 45 minutes is not a separate TESDA follow-up minimum. Authored independent study estimate: 10–12 minutes, based on six screens with 324.31 seconds of English or 347.27 seconds of Filipino encoded narration, plus about 4–6 minutes for reading/check/reflection; optional stories and replay are additional. Use six screens, fictional cards, blank notebook and pens; no private documents.

## [prepare] Prepare

Read both languages in Read/Slides and the source audit. Confirm the local contact and accessible channel with the health team; mark unknowns and invent no office or deadline. Prepare three learner cards and three staff cards below. Require no disclosure of accreditation, benefits or personal distress. The packaged activity is adapted to follow-up only: the CSC website references CS Form 101-H revised Dec.2011, but download bytes are not yet verified; this package performs no official-form demonstration or submission.

## [opening] Opening

For 5 minutes, show fictional Demi: she provided an application but has no confirmed update. Ask what is known and unconfirmed. Acknowledge worry without blaming silence. Learners need not share personal delays. They may answer on a card, in their preferred language or with support.

## [steps] Steps

1. Opening and known/unknown facts (5 minutes).
2. Model pausing if helpful, purpose and the section-6 question (5). Show respectful firmness without a guarantee.
3. Compare Cards A/B/C (5).
4. Three role-play rounds: learner, contact and observer; 5 minutes each including brief clarification (15).
5. Observer feedback, reflection and re-practice using a different staff card (10).
6. Application check, every rationale and one realistic next-contact note (5). Optional video is unnecessary for online completion.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

Known: a fictional application was provided. Unknown: receipt, completeness, status, cause, responsibility and date. Card A needs a named application and purpose; a vague question is not a moral failure. Card B has a clear purpose and verification question. Card C guesses a lost document and requirement; ask what needs checking first. If a learner expresses frustration, acknowledge it and help form the question. If the contact is unknown, record that uncertainty and confirm with the health team; do not invent it.

## [misconception] Common misconception

“A long wait means approval.” Time alone proves no decision. “A document must be lost.” The cause remains unknown until confirmed. “You must show no emotion to pass.” Accent, feelings, a quiet personality and assertiveness are not skill scores. Observe the specific question, facts/unknowns, clarification and bounded next step. Calmness guarantees neither a response nor a benefit.

## [practice] Practice activity

Learner cards: A vague question; B specific verification question; C a guessed lost document (full text on screen 3). Staff card 1: “Still under review. No date yet.” Staff card 2: “An item needs verification; let us clarify which item and how.” Staff card 3: “I cannot confirm who is responsible.” These are fictional responses only. Rotate through three rounds. Learner: purpose, facts/unknowns, specific question, repeat the response, clarify the next contact. Observer: record what was actually said and one suggestion. Re-practice after feedback. Worksheet: fictional purpose / confirmed response / remaining question / agreed next contact. Use no real ID or document.

## [answer-key] Self-check answer key

One three-choice check appears on the final Read and Slide screen. First: correct, it verifies receipt/status, listens and clarifies the next step with the appropriate contact. Second: a long wait does not establish automatic approval. Third: it guesses a lost document and requirement; resubmitting everything first is unsupported. Explain every rationale; accept equivalent wording. An online correct answer is separate from observed skill.

## [observe] What to observe

Use one objective_index 0 indicator. Kaya na: independently distinguishes facts/unknowns, asks specifically, repeats/clarifies the response and identifies a bounded next step on two staff cards. Kailangan practice: sound direction but a prompt is needed for one action. Hindi pa: still guesses cause/approval or cannot form a specific question/clarification after support; model and repeat. Accent, nervousness, anger and using a written question do not establish incompetence. Do not score an administrative outcome.

## [support] If more support is needed

Offer a four-part cue card: facts and unknowns / question / understood response and clarification / next contact. Learners may read, write, listen to or dictate the question. Pair with a supportive partner, allow an observer round first and model staff card 1. Ask about preferred language and accessible method. Fade prompts in the second practice and re-observe. Require no real delay story or personal distress disclosure.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Audit 5 October 2026: original DOH Facilitator Guide PDF23/printed16 (126-page file, exact SHA in audit); TESDA BHS NCII Revision01, unit400311213 PDF19–20/printed15–16 and PDF86–87/printed82–83. Supports emotion management, reflection, communication/self-regulation and three hours for the whole competency. Demi, all cards, specific questions, contact planning and the 45-minute split are authored applications, not statutory intervals or empirical promises. Original Day1 PDF25 has no printed slide number and lists optional CSC form practice. Current form evidence is a CSC website reference; download bytes remain unverified, so the demonstration is adapted/omitted. Target LGU procedure, full national IRR/amendment history, independent policy SME approval and human listening are unverified. New lesson/media are draft for separate owner review.

read_sections.body_en:
Now try it yourself. A newly accredited BHW in your barangay is confused about how to file their first report. Who is the most fitting person to approach — not the midwife, not barangay officials, but someone with the same experience as a BHW?

Think of the answer before moving on: a more experienced fellow BHW is the easiest person to go to for this — not because it's a lesser concern, but because that is exactly where the everyday, practical know-how of the work actually lives.
read_sections.body_fil:
Ngayon, subukan mo. May BHW na bagong-tanggap sa inyong barangay at nalilito kung paano mag-file ng kanyang unang ulat. Sino kaya ang pinakaangkop na lapitan niya — hindi ang midwife, hindi rin ang barangay officials, kundi ang taong may parehong karanasan bilang BHW?

Isipin ang sagot bago magpatuloy: ang kapwa BHW na mas matagal na sa gawain ang pinakamadaling puntahan para dito — hindi dahil mas mababa ang usapin, kundi dahil doon talaga umiikot ang karanasan sa pang-araw-araw na mga detalye ng trabaho.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Not every question is for the midwife or barangay officials — some things a fellow BHW is simply the closest person to answer.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi lahat ng katanungan ay para sa midwife o barangay officials — may mga bagay na ang kapwa BHW mismo ang may pinakamalapit na sagot.

read_sections.body_en:
**Wrong**: BHW Marites went straight to the barangay captain about Aling Nena's child's cough, because "he's the one I usually talk to anyway." The barangay captain's time was wasted on a clinical matter outside his role, and the proper referral was delayed.

**Right**: BHW Marites first recognized the clinical nature of the concern, approached the midwife/RHU, and only involved barangay officials once transport support to the facility was actually needed.
read_sections.body_fil:
**Mali**: Pinuntahan agad ni BHW Marites ang barangay captain para sa ubo ni anak ni Aling Nena, dahil "siya naman ang laging kausap ko." Nasayang ang oras ng barangay captain sa usaping klinikal na hindi naman niya saklaw, at naantala ang tamang pag-refer.

**Tama**: Kinilala muna ni BHW Marites ang klinikal na katangian ng alalahanin, lumapit sa midwife/RHU, at kalaunan ay isinama ang barangay officials lamang kapag may kailangan nang suportang pantransportasyon papunta sa pasilidad.

read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang paglapit sa maling tao ay hindi lang nakakaubos ng oras — naaantala rin nito ang serbisyong dapat sana'y mabilis.
