private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin

Magsanay sa isang mungkahing maisasagawa: ilarawan ang factual na concern at dahilan, magmungkahi ng praktikal na unang hakbang na may policy, responsibility at service checks, at sabihin kung kanino lalapit at ang napagkasunduang follow-up. Saklaw ito ng iisang pinanatiling objective, index 0.

## [time-materials] Oras at materyales

Mungkahing facilitated activity: 20 minuto kasama ang pagbabahagi ng panukala at feedback. Sariling pag-aaral: humigit-kumulang 10 minuto sa anim na screen at check; dagdag ang opsyonal na kuwento. Authored estimates ang mga ito. Inirerekomenda ng manual ang hindi bababa sa apat na oras para sa buong workplace competency; 200 minuto ang inherited module table, kaya may 40-minutong gap na aayusin ng organizer. Hindi apat na oras bawat aralin; huwag tahimik na baguhin ang oras ng sibling. Gumamit ng blangkong proposal cards at fictional scenarios; walang patient records, repair o equipment demonstration.

## [prepare] Maghanda

Kumpirmahin sa health team ang lokal na contact, saklaw ng pahintulot sa panukalang proseso at umiiral na room-use procedure. Markahan ang hindi pa alam. Tiyaking angkop sa lugar ang nonclinical meeting-area example. Basahin ang docs/lesson-135-source-audit.json. Hindi sapat ang titulong supervisor upang ipalagay na may pahintulot sa lahat ng pagbabago.

## [opening] Panimula

Gamitin ang 2 minuto: balikan ang pagtingin ni Mimi sa meeting area sa 1.3.4. Sa fictional na pagpapatuloy, may nakumpirmang susunod na gamit ngunit hindi malinaw ang paalala kung sino ang titingin sa schedule. Ihiwalay ang factual na concern sa pangkalahatang reklamo.

## [steps] Mga hakbang

1. Sabihin ang factual na concern at hindi pa alam (3 minuto).
2. Bumuo ng isang praktikal na panukala at dahilan; tingnan ang umiiral na proseso (3 minuto).
3. Tukuyin ang polisiya, pahintulot, oras, materyales at service needs (3 minuto).
4. Pair practice, ibahagi ang panukala at magpalit ng role; magkasundo kung sino ang susuri, ano at kailan muling mag-uusap (6 minuto).
5. Ipaliwanag ang tatlong pagpipilian at magbigay ng feedback (3 minuto). Kasama ang 2-minutong panimula, 20 minuto ang kabuuan. Hindi kailangan ang opsyonal na video para sa online completion.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Concern: walang malinaw na paalala kung sino ang titingin sa schedule pagkatapos ng meeting; nakumpirma ang susunod na gawain. Panukala: suriin kung kailangan ng maikling checklist o linawin ang umiiral na paalala. Dahilan: bawasan ang kalituhan sa schedule at handover, walang claim ng measured savings. Checks: umiiral na proseso, lokal na tuntunin, pahintulot, responsable, oras/materyales at service/safety needs. Follow-up: susuriin ng contact at Mimi ang proseso sa susunod na meeting; itala kung sino, ano at kailan. Kasunduan ito sa review, hindi pahintulot na magpatupad.

## [misconception] Karaniwang maling akala

“Maliit lang ang trial, kaya puwedeng simulan bago may pahintulot.” Itanong kung anong tungkulin o service needs ang maaapektuhan. Kahit checklist ay maaaring magtakda ng gawain o sumalungat sa proseso. Hindi pahintulot ang pagsang-ayon ng kasamahan. Hindi isang praktikal na panukala ang “ayusin lahat”; tulungang pumili ng tiyak na concern, unang hakbang at napagkasunduang follow-up.

## [practice] Pagsasanay

Card A: walang malinaw na paalala sa pagtingin sa schedule ng meeting area. Gumawa ng apat na linya: obserbasyon; isang panukalang review at dahilan; dapat tiyakin sa responsable; napagkasunduang follow-up. Card B: gustong ilagay agad ng kasamahan ang checklist at atasan ang lahat. Ipaliwanag kung bakit kailangan muna ng lokal na review at pahintulot, saka gumawa ng panukalang nasa saklaw. Ibahagi, tumanggap ng feedback, magpalit ng role at ulitin. Walang real patient data o aktuwal na pagbabago.

## [answer-key] Susi sa self-check

Tama ang choice 1: tiyak na concern, isang panukalang review at dahilan, pagsusuri ng umiiral na proseso, pahintulot at service needs, at napagkasunduang contact/oras. Choice 2: nagpapatupad bago may pahintulot; hindi pahintulot ang trial at magandang intensiyon. Choice 3: pangkalahatang hiling, may hindi nasukat na claim sa pera, at walang unang hakbang o napagkasunduang follow-up. Ipaliwanag ang bawat dahilan sa sariling salita.

## [observe] Dapat obserbahan

Isang indicator sa objective 0 na may tatlong kilos: factual na concern/dahilan; praktikal na panukala na may policy/responsibility/service checks; pakikipag-usap kung kanino lalapit at napagkasunduang follow-up, walang kilos o pangakong lampas sa pahintulot. Kaya na: lahat sa dalawang card nang walang prompt. Kailangan practice: maayos ang panukala ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa checks o follow-up. Hindi pa: kumikilos muna, nangangako ng approval/savings o walang tiyak na panukala. Hiwalay ang observed practice sa online completion.

## [support] Kung kailangan ng dagdag na suporta

Gamitin ang apat na linyang cue card: obserbasyon → panukala at dahilan → checks/contact → napagkasunduang follow-up. Magmodelo ng panukala. Palitan ang pangkalahatang reklamo ng tiyak na concern, saka tukuyin ang kilos na walang pahintulot o unsupported promise. Ulitin sa gustong wika, bawasan ang prompt, at muling obserbahan ang dalawang card matapos ang feedback. Kung hindi alam ang contact, kumpirmahin sa health team at magkasundo sa practice follow-up; huwag mag-imbento ng pahintulot.

private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Practice one workable proposal: describe a factual concern and reason, propose a feasible first step with policy, responsibility and service checks, and communicate who to ask and an agreed follow-up. These actions belong to the one preserved objective, index 0.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

Suggested facilitated activity: 20 minutes including proposal sharing and feedback. Independent study: about 10 minutes for six screens and the check; optional story additional. Both are authored estimates. The manual recommends at least four hours for the whole workplace competency; the inherited module table totals 200 minutes, leaving a 40-minute organizer gap. Do not allocate four hours to each lesson or silently change sibling timing. Use blank proposal cards and fictional scenarios; no patient records, repairs or equipment demonstrations.

## [prepare] Prepare

Confirm the local responsible contact, authority for the proposed process and existing room-use procedure with the health team. Mark unknowns for confirmation. Check that the nonclinical meeting-area example fits the setting. Read docs/lesson-135-source-audit.json. A supervisor title alone does not establish authority for every change.

## [opening] Opening

Use 2 minutes: recall Mimi checking the meeting area in 1.3.4. In this fictional continuation, another use is confirmed but the reminder of who checks the schedule is unclear. Ask learners to separate the factual concern from a general complaint.

## [steps] Steps

1. State the factual concern and what remains unknown (3 minutes).
2. Draft one feasible proposal and its reason; check for an existing process (3 minutes).
3. Identify policy, authority, time, materials and service needs (3 minutes).
4. Pair practice, share proposals and swap roles; agree who reviews what and when to speak again (6 minutes).
5. Explain all three application choices and give feedback (3 minutes). Together with the 2-minute opening this totals 20 minutes. The optional video is not required for online completion.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

Concern: no clear reminder of who checks the schedule after meetings; another activity is confirmed. Proposal: review whether a short meeting-end checklist is needed, or clarify an existing reminder. Reason: reduce confusion in schedule checking and handover, without claiming measured savings. Checks: existing process, local rule, authority, responsible person, available time/materials and service/safety needs. Follow-up: confirmed contact and Mimi review the process at the next meeting; record who, what and when. This is agreement to review, not permission to implement.

## [misconception] Common misconception

“A trial is small, so we can start before permission.” Ask what duties or service needs could change. Even a checklist may assign work or conflict with an existing procedure. A colleague agreeing is not authorization. “Fix everything” is not one feasible proposal; help the learner choose a specific concern, a first step and an agreed follow-up.

## [practice] Practice activity

Card A: the meeting-area schedule check has no clear reminder. Draft four lines: observation; one proposed review step and reason; what to verify with the confirmed responsible person; agreed follow-up. Card B: a colleague suggests posting the checklist immediately and assigning everyone a duty. Explain why that needs local review and permission first, then make a bounded proposal. Share aloud, receive feedback, swap roles and repeat. Do not use real patient data or perform changes.

## [answer-key] Self-check answer key

Choice 1 is correct: specific concern, one proposed checklist review and reason, checks of the existing process, authority and service needs, and an agreed review contact/time. Choice 2 implements before authorization; a trial and good intentions do not give permission. Choice 3 is a general demand, assumes unmeasured money waste and has no clear first step or agreed follow-up. Ask the learner to explain each rationale in their own words.

## [observe] What to observe

Use one indicator for objective 0, grouping three actions: factual concern/reason; feasible proposal with policy/responsibility/service checks; communication of who to ask and agreed follow-up without acting or promising beyond authority. Kaya na: all three on both cards without prompts. Kailangan practice: sound proposal but checks or follow-up need prompts. Hindi pa: acts first, promises approval/savings or cannot state a specific proposal. Record observed practice separately from online completion.

## [support] If a BHW needs more support

Use a four-line cue card: observation → proposal and reason → checks/contact → agreed follow-up. Model one proposal. Have the learner replace a general complaint with a specific concern, then identify any unauthorized action or unsupported promise. Let them repeat in their preferred language, fade prompts, and re-observe both cards after feedback. If a local contact is unknown, help confirm it through the health team and agree a practice follow-up; do not invent authority.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Audited 4 October 2026: DOH BHW Facilitator Manual (2022), printed p.15 / original PDF p.24, Recommendations on Training. Cached original freshly reopened and rendered after fresh web retrieval exceeded the size limit. The repository transcription calls this Page 22; do not use it as the original PDF page. Supports workplace best practices, communication, efficient resources and whole-competency minimum timing. Mimi, the checklist, local questions and follow-up are authored fictional applications. No plastics legal claim, universal approval chain, guaranteed savings, repair or clinical cuts are taught. Contradictory old practice-map omitted from new revision; historical file retained. The owner approved the reviewed 1.3.5 package on 4 October 2026; see docs/lesson-135-owner-approval.json. No independent SME approval or human listening claim. See docs/lesson-135-source-audit.json.

objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: benefits and conditions.

read_sections.body_en:
In this fictional story, someone tells Demi: “Every BHW gets the same allowance automatically.” She does not know whether this is correct. Her accreditation and registration have not been verified either. Instead of promising money, she asks which benefit they mean and which conditions need checking.

RA 7883 provides six categories of benefits. They have different purposes, conditions and responsible authorities. The story video is optional; you can complete Read or Slides without watching it.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa kathang-isip na kuwento, may nagsabi kay Demi: “Pare-pareho at awtomatiko ang allowance ng lahat ng BHW.” Hindi niya alam kung tama ito. Hindi pa rin natitiyak ang kaniyang akreditasyon at rehistrasyon. Sa halip na mangako ng pera, itinanong niya kung anong benepisyo ang tinutukoy at anong kondisyon ang dapat alamin.

Ang RA 7883 ay may anim na kategorya ng benepisyo. Magkakaiba ang layunin, kondisyon at awtoridad na kaugnay ng mga ito. Opsyonal ang kuwentong video; maaari mong tapusin ang Read o Slides nang hindi ito pinapanood.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Name the benefit and verify its conditions before promising anything.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Pangalanan ang benepisyo at tiyakin ang kondisyon bago mangako.

read_sections.body_en:
Section 6 of RA 7883 includes hazard allowance and subsistence allowance. Each has its own conditions; we will compare them on a later screen.

It also includes training, education and career enrichment programs: opportunities for continuing education, training and other educational support. The Act also provides tuition scholarship benefits in state colleges for one child of a BHW unable to use those programs. Civil service eligibility is a separate category with its own CSC qualifications and application; lesson 1.4.3 covers it.

Free legal representation and consultation through the Public Attorney’s Office cover cases arising from or connected with BHW duties, including coercion or interference. Preferential access to loans concerns organized BHW groups with community-based income-generating projects supporting health programs. It is not a promise of a loan to every individual.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa seksiyon 6 ng RA 7883, kabilang ang hazard allowance at subsistence allowance. May sariling kondisyon ang bawat isa; ihahambing natin ang mga ito sa susunod na screen.

Kasama rin ang training, education at career enrichment programs: mga pagkakataon sa patuloy na pag-aaral, pagsasanay at iba pang suportang pang-edukasyon. May nakasaad ding scholarship sa tuition sa state colleges para sa isang anak ng BHW na hindi makikinabang sa mga programang iyon. Ang civil service eligibility ay hiwalay na kategorya na may sariling kwalipikasyon at aplikasyon sa CSC; tatalakayin ito sa aralin 1.4.3.

Ang libreng legal representation at consultation ng Public Attorney’s Office ay para sa mga kasong kaugnay ng pagganap ng tungkulin bilang BHW, kabilang ang coercion o interference. Ang preferential access sa loans ay para sa organisadong mga grupo ng BHW na may community-based income-generating projects na sumusuporta sa mga programang pangkalusugan. Hindi ito pangako ng pautang sa bawat indibidwal.
read_sections.takeaway_en: There are six categories; they are not all monthly payments or personal loans.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Anim ang kategorya; hindi lahat ay buwanang bayad o personal na pautang.

read_sections.body_en:
Section 4 requires registration with the local health board of the city or municipality where service is rendered to receive the Act’s benefits and incentives. It also provides appropriate proof of accreditation. Accreditation and registration are related but distinct. Section 6 refers to accredited BHWs actively and regularly performing their duties, alongside the conditions of each benefit.

Under section 5, DOH determines the ideal ratio of BHWs to households. The total number of BHWs nationwide must not exceed one percent of the total population. This gives us no basis to invent a barangay quota or decide Demi’s qualification.

Section 7 requires local health board review and approval for benefits using local funds. Not receiving a benefit does not prove that a BHW did something wrong or failed to register. Check the applicable conditions and local implementation without blame.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa seksiyon 4, kailangang magparehistro sa local health board ng lungsod o munisipyo kung saan naglilingkod upang makinabang sa mga benepisyo at insentibo ng batas. May angkop na patunay ng akreditasyon. Magkaugnay ngunit hindi mapagpapalit ang akreditasyon at rehistrasyon. Ang seksiyon 6 ay tumutukoy sa mga akreditadong BHW na aktibo at regular na gumaganap ng kanilang tungkulin, kasama ang partikular na kondisyon ng bawat benepisyo.

Sa seksiyon 5, DOH ang magtatakda ng ideal na ratio ng BHW sa bilang ng mga sambahayan. Ang kabuuang bilang ng BHW sa buong bansa ay hindi dapat lumampas sa isang porsiyento ng kabuuang populasyon. Hindi ito batayan upang gumawa tayo ng quota sa isang barangay o hulaan kung kwalipikado si Demi.

Sa seksiyon 7, ang benepisyong gagamit ng lokal na pondo ay kailangang repasuhin at aprubahan ng local health board. Kung hindi pa natatanggap ang benepisyo, hindi nito pinatutunayang nagkamali o hindi nagparehistro ang BHW. Alamin ang naaangkop na kondisyon at lokal na pagpapatupad nang walang pagsisi.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Registration is required; it does not guarantee every benefit.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Kailangan ang rehistrasyon; hindi nito ginagarantiya ang bawat benepisyo.

read_sections.body_en:
Card A: a fictional volunteer BHW may face risk in the workplace while performing duties. Under section 6(a), hazard allowance concerns foreseeable but unavoidable danger affecting health or life during duty, validated by the proper authorities. The local health board and local peace and order council of the LGU determine the amount. Calling a place “dangerous” does not let us validate the exposure or set payment ourselves.

Card B: a fictional BHW serves within an isolated barangay health station to make services available at any and all times. Under section 6(b), subsistence allowance is equivalent to meals taken during duty, computed according to prevailing circumstances determined by the LGU. A distant home alone is not the statutory condition.

A and B need different verification questions. Their status, validation and approved local amounts are unknown; we promise no receipt of benefits.
read_sections.body_fil:
Card A: isang kathang-isip na boluntaryong BHW ang maaaring malantad sa panganib sa lugar ng trabaho habang ginagampanan ang tungkulin. Sa seksiyon 6(a), ang hazard allowance ay para sa foreseeable ngunit unavoidable na panganib na makaaapekto sa kalusugan o buhay habang nagtatrabaho, na dapat i-validate ng tamang awtoridad. Local health board at local peace and order council ng LGU ang magtatakda ng halaga. Hindi sapat ang label na “mapanganib” upang tayo ang magpatunay o magtakda ng bayad.

Card B: isang kathang-isip na BHW ang naglilingkod sa loob ng isolated barangay health station upang maibigay ang serbisyo anumang oras. Sa seksiyon 6(b), ang subsistence allowance ay katumbas ng mga pagkaing kinakain sa panahon ng tungkulin, na kinukuwenta ayon sa umiiral na kalagayang itinatakda ng LGU. Ang “malayo ang bahay” lamang ay hindi ang kondisyon sa batas.

Magkaibang tanong sa verification ang kailangan ng A at B. Hindi natin alam ang kanilang katayuan, validation o aprubadong lokal na halaga; walang pangako ng pagtanggap.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Check the specific service and conditions; do not assume one fixed amount.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Tingnan ang tiyak na serbisyo at kondisyon; huwag magtakda ng iisang halaga.

read_sections.body_en:
Demi explains: “RA 7883 has six categories with different conditions. Registration where service is rendered is required, and one credential does not establish qualification for every benefit.”

She asks her supervisor or RHU: “For hazard allowance, who is the right contact to verify accreditation and registration, the required exposure evidence, validation by proper authorities, and local review and approval?” The RHU can help identify the contact; it does not replace the statutory authorities. For legal services, the case must connect with BHW duties and PAO is the named provider; for eligibility, CSC is the relevant office.

Demi uses only a blank question sheet. It is not an official form, application, approval or proof of her status. Use fictional cases in practice; no one needs to share private records or a personal benefit-receipt history.
read_sections.body_fil:
Ipinaliwanag ni Demi: “May anim na kategorya sa RA 7883, pero magkakaiba ang kondisyon. Kailangan ang rehistrasyon kung saan naglilingkod, at hindi sapat ang isang credential para sa lahat ng benepisyo.”

Tanong niya sa supervisor o RHU: “Para sa hazard allowance, sino ang tamang contact upang matiyak ang akreditasyon at rehistrasyon, ang kailangang ebidensiya ng exposure, ang validation ng tamang awtoridad, at ang lokal na review at pag-apruba?” Maaaring tumulong ang RHU sa pag-alam ng contact; hindi nito pinapalitan ang mga awtoridad sa batas. Kung legal services ang tanong, kaugnay ng tungkulin ang kaso at PAO ang tinutukoy na provider; kung eligibility, CSC ang kaugnay na tanggapan.

Blankong question sheet lamang ang ginagamit ni Demi. Hindi ito opisyal na form, aplikasyon, approval o patunay ng kaniyang katayuan. Gumamit ng kathang-isip na kaso sa pagsasanay; hindi kailangang magbahagi ng pribadong rekord o kasaysayan ng pagtanggap ng benepisyo.
read_sections.heading_fil: Ang tiyak na tanong ni Demi
read_sections.takeaway_en: Ask a specific question without promising money or an outcome.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Magtanong nang tiyak at walang pangakong pera o resulta.

options.en: Explain status and registration, validated duty-related exposure and applicable local review; ask the RHU for the appropriate evidence and authority contact before promising anything.
options.fil: Ipaliwanag na kailangan ang katayuan at rehistrasyon, validated na exposure sa tungkulin at naaangkop na local review; itanong sa RHU ang tamang contact para sa ebidensiya at awtoridad bago mangako.

options.en: Promise the same automatic allowance to everyone; all BHW benefits are the same.
options.fil: Ipangako ang awtomatikong pare-parehong allowance sa lahat; iisa naman ang benepisyo ng BHW.

options.en: Registration or one credential is enough for all allowances, CSC eligibility and a personal loan; no other conditions need checking.
options.fil: Sapat ang rehistrasyon o isang credential para sa lahat ng allowance, CSC eligibility at personal na loan; hindi na kailangan ang ibang kondisyon.

check.prompt_en: What is Demi’s best response about hazard allowance?
check.prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamainam na tugon ni Demi tungkol sa hazard allowance?
check.feedback_en: First: correct. Hazard allowance has shared status/registration requirements and specific conditions, including proper-authority validation; local funds also require board review/approval. Asking the RHU for a contact is reasonable, without replacing the authorities. Second: incorrect. Conditions and authorities differ; automatic identical payment is unsupported. Third: incorrect. One credential cannot replace exposure, each benefit’s conditions, local review or a separate CSC application; loan access concerns organized groups and qualifying projects, not a personal guarantee.
check.feedback_fil: Una: tama. May shared status/registration requirements at specific conditions ang hazard allowance, kabilang ang validation ng tamang awtoridad; kailangan din ang board review/approval kapag lokal na pondo. Makatwirang contact question ang RHU, hindi kapalit ng awtoridad. Ikalawa: mali. Magkakaiba ang kondisyon at awtoridad; walang batayan ang awtomatikong pantay na bayad. Ikatlo: mali. Hindi pinapalitan ng isang credential ang exposure, kondisyon ng bawat benepisyo, local review o hiwalay na CSC application; para sa organisadong grupo at qualifying projects ang loan access, hindi personal na garantiya.

read_sections.body_en:
Demi hears that every BHW receives the same allowance. Someone asks about hazard allowance, but status, exposure and local approval are still unverified. What explanation and first step fit best?

Choose the answer naming the benefit, its specific conditions and appropriate verification. Then explain why the other two choices are insufficient. Finishing the online lesson is separate from a facilitator observing this competency.
read_sections.body_fil:
Narinig ni Demi na pare-pareho raw ang allowance ng lahat ng BHW. May nagtanong tungkol sa hazard allowance, pero hindi pa verified ang katayuan, exposure o lokal na pag-apruba. Ano ang pinakamainam na paliwanag at unang hakbang?

Piliin ang sagot na may benepisyo, tiyak na kondisyon at tamang verification. Pagkatapos, ipaliwanag kung bakit hindi sapat ang dalawang ibang pagpipilian. Hiwalay ang pagtatapos ng online lesson sa pagmamasid ng facilitator sa kakayahang ito.
read_sections.heading_en: Choose an explanation with an appropriate step
read_sections.heading_fil: Piliin ang paliwanag na may angkop na hakbang
read_sections.takeaway_en: Explain the condition and choose an appropriate verification step.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ipaliwanag ang kondisyon at piliin ang naaangkop na verification.

Card A: isang kathang-isip na boluntaryong BHW ang maaaring malantad sa panganib sa lugar ng trabaho habang ginagampanan ang tungkulin. Sa seksiyon 6(a), ang hazard allowance ay para sa foreseeable ngunit unavoidable na panganib na makaaapekto sa kalusugan o buhay habang nagtatrabaho, na dapat i-validate ng tamang awtoridad. Local health board at local peace and order council ng LGU ang magtatakda ng halaga. Hindi sapat ang label na “mapanganib” upang tayo ang magpatunay o magtakda ng bayad.

Card B: isang kathang-isip na BHW ang naglilingkod sa loob ng isolated barangay health station upang maibigay ang serbisyo anumang oras. Sa seksiyon 6(b), ang subsistence allowance ay katumbas ng mga pagkaing kinakain sa panahon ng tungkulin, na kinukuwenta ayon sa umiiral na kalagayang itinatakda ng LGU. Ang “malayo ang bahay” lamang ay hindi ang kondisyon sa batas.

Magkaibang tanong sa verification ang kailangan ng A at B. Hindi natin alam ang kanilang katayuan, validation o aprubadong lokal na halaga; walang pangako ng pagtanggap.

slides.heading_fil: Ang tiyak na tanong ni Demi
slides.narration_en:
Demi explains: “RA 7883 has six categories with different conditions. Registration where service is rendered is required, and one credential does not establish qualification for every benefit.”

She asks her supervisor or RHU: “For hazard allowance, who is the right contact to verify accreditation and registration, the required exposure evidence, validation by proper authorities, and local review and approval?” The RHU can help identify the contact; it does not replace the statutory authorities. For legal services, the case must connect with BHW duties and PAO is the named provider; for eligibility, CSC is the relevant office.

Demi uses only a blank question sheet. It is not an official form, application, approval or proof of her status. Use fictional cases in practice; no one needs to share private records or a personal benefit-receipt history.
slides.narration_fil:
Ipinaliwanag ni Demi: “May anim na kategorya sa RA 7883, pero magkakaiba ang kondisyon. Kailangan ang rehistrasyon kung saan naglilingkod, at hindi sapat ang isang credential para sa lahat ng benepisyo.”

Tanong niya sa supervisor o RHU: “Para sa hazard allowance, sino ang tamang contact upang matiyak ang akreditasyon at rehistrasyon, ang kailangang ebidensiya ng exposure, ang validation ng tamang awtoridad, at ang lokal na review at pag-apruba?” Maaaring tumulong ang RHU sa pag-alam ng contact; hindi nito pinapalitan ang mga awtoridad sa batas. Kung legal services ang tanong, kaugnay ng tungkulin ang kaso at PAO ang tinutukoy na provider; kung eligibility, CSC ang kaugnay na tanggapan.

Blankong question sheet lamang ang ginagamit ni Demi. Hindi ito opisyal na form, aplikasyon, approval o patunay ng kaniyang katayuan. Gumamit ng kathang-isip na kaso sa pagsasanay; hindi kailangang magbahagi ng pribadong rekord o kasaysayan ng pagtanggap ng benepisyo.

options.fil: Ipangako ang awtomatikong pare-parehong allowance sa lahat; iisa naman ang benepisyo ng BHW.

options.en: Registration or one credential is enough for all allowances, CSC eligibility and a personal loan; no other conditions need checking.

check.feedback_en: First: correct. Hazard allowance has shared status/registration requirements and specific conditions, including proper-authority validation; local funds also require board review/approval. Asking the RHU for a contact is reasonable, without replacing the authorities. Second: incorrect. Conditions and authorities differ; automatic identical payment is unsupported. Third: incorrect. One credential cannot replace exposure, each benefit’s conditions, local review or a separate CSC application; loan access concerns organized groups and qualifying projects, not a personal guarantee.

May shared status/registration requirements at specific conditions ang hazard allowance, kabilang ang validation ng tamang awtoridad; kailangan din ang board review/approval kapag lokal na pondo. Makatwirang contact question ang RHU, hindi kapalit ng awtoridad. Ikalawa: mali. Magkakaiba ang kondisyon at awtoridad; walang batayan ang awtomatikong pantay na bayad. Ikatlo: mali. Hindi pinapalitan ng isang credential ang exposure, kondisyon ng bawat benepisyo, local review o hiwalay na CSC application; para sa organisadong grupo at qualifying projects ang loan access, hindi personal na garantiya.

private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin

Ipaliwanag at ilapat ang benepisyo at kondisyon sa kathang-isip na kaso ni Demi. Pangalanan ang anim na kategorya, ihiwalay ang rehistrasyon/akreditasyon at kondisyon ng bawat benepisyo, at pumili ng angkop na verification nang walang pangakong pera. Iisa ang objective ng aralin, index 0.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

Panatilihin ang 30 minuto sa kasalukuyang 180-minutong plano ng module: opening 3, paliwanag na may halimbawa 8, Card A/B practice 10, check at feedback 5, observation at re-practice 4. Authored ang hatian. Tinatayang 10–12 minuto ang self-study, hindi kasama ang opsyonal na kuwento o replay. Para sa buong competency ang tatlong oras sa manual, hindi bawat aralin. Kagamitan: listahan ng anim na kategorya, kathang-isip na Card A/Card B sa ibaba, blankong question sheets, markers at Read/Slides. Walang kailangang personal na rekord o checklist ng natanggap na benepisyo.

## [prepare] Paghahanda

Basahin ang dalawang wika at ang na-audit na seksiyon 4–7 ng RA 7883. Bago magturo, tiyakin ang kasalukuyang pagpapatupad at contact sa local health board/LGU at kaugnay na provider. Itala lamang ang verified; sabihing hindi pa alam ang hindi natitiyak. Kasama ang board at peace and order council sa hazard amount; LGU sa subsistence computation. Independiyenteng tiyakin ang kasalukuyang national implementing rules at lokal na proseso; summary lamang ang lumang DOH FAQ, hindi buong IRR. Huwag kumuwenta ng barangay slots mula sa nationwide cap o mangopya ng form ng ibang LGU. Panatilihin ang oras ng ibang aralin.

## [opening] Panimula

Basahin ang kathang-isip na narinig ni Demi: “Awtomatiko at pare-pareho ang allowance ng lahat ng BHW.” Anyayahan silang pag-usapan ang pahayag, nang hindi tinatanong ang personal na rehistrasyon o kasaysayan ng benepisyo. Sabihin: “Igalang natin ang tanong at tingnan ang kondisyon. Hindi patunay ng pagkakamali ang hindi pagtanggap.”

## [steps] Mga hakbang

1. Ipakita ang anim na kategorya sa section-3: hazard, subsistence, training/education/career enrichment, civil service eligibility, libreng legal services at preferential loan access. Igrupo bilang allowance, pag-unlad at suporta. Ipaliwanag ang pagkakataong pang-edukasyon, conditional tuition scholarship ng anak, PAO services para sa kasong kaugnay ng tungkulin, at loan access ng organisadong grupo para sa proyektong sumusuporta sa kalusugan. Hindi ito anim na buwanang cash payment.
2. Ipaliwanag ang seksiyon 4: rehistrasyon sa board ng lungsod/munisipyo kung saan naglilingkod at angkop na patunay ng akreditasyon. Sa seksiyon 6, saklaw ang akreditadong BHW na aktibo at regular ang tungkulin, kasama ang kondisyon ng bawat benepisyo. Hindi sapat ang isang credential para sa lahat. Sa seksiyon 7, kailangan ang board review/approval kapag lokal na pondo ang gagamitin.
3. Sa seksiyon 5, DOH ang magtatakda ng ideal na ratio ng BHW sa sambahayan; nationwide ang one-percent population cap. Hindi ito imbentong barangay quota o personal na desisyon sa eligibility.
4. I-model ang Card A: ang posibleng foreseeable ngunit unavoidable na panganib sa tungkulin ay kailangang i-validate ng tamang awtoridad. Board at peace and order council ang magtatakda ng halaga. Itanong kung sino ang contact para sa kasalukuyang ebidensiya at validation. Huwag tayo ang mag-validate ng exposure.
5. I-model ang Card B: serbisyo sa loob ng isolated BHS upang available anumang oras; katumbas ng pagkain sa tungkulin ang allowance, kinukuwenta ng LGU ayon sa umiiral na kalagayan. Hindi sapat ang malayong bahay. Itanong ang service evidence at lokal na computation.
6. I-model ang tanong ni Demi tungkol sa benepisyo, katayuan/ebidensiya, kondisyon at awtoridad. Maaaring ituro ng RHU/supervisor ang contact ngunit hindi nito pinapalitan ang statutory authority. Ituro ang CSC eligibility sa 1.4.3. Opsyonal ang kuwentong video.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot at supportive feedback

“Magkaiba ang hazard at subsistence; validation ang tingnan sa A at serbisyo sa isolated station sa B.” Tugon: “Naipagkaiba mo ang benepisyo at kondisyon. Pangalanan ngayon ang contact at dapat i-verify.”

“Sapat na ang rehistrasyon para sa lahat.” Tugon: “Kailangan ang rehistrasyon. Idagdag ang aktibo at regular na tungkulin, tiyak na kondisyon ng benepisyo, at local-fund review kung naaangkop.”

“Hindi nagparehistro ang hindi nakatanggap.” Tugon: “Hindi natin mahihinuha iyon. Tiyakin ang facts at pagpapatupad nang walang pagsisi.”

“Lahat ng unrelated cases ay saklaw ng PAO” o “bawat indibidwal ay may loan.” Tugon: “Iugnay ang kaso sa tungkulin bilang BHW; ang loan access sa organisadong grupo at qualifying health-supporting projects.” Hindi kailangang kabisado agad ang bawat clause; maaaring gamitin ang listahan.

## [misconception] Karaniwang maling pagkaunawa

Awtomatiko at pare-parehong allowance ang lahat ng benepisyo. Akreditasyon/rehistrasyon lamang ang sapat para sa bawat bayad. National cap ang nagtatakda ng lokal na slots. Itama gamit ang kaugnay na seksiyon at ebidensiya nang hindi nag-iimbento ng pera, quota o approval. Magkaiba ang enacted law at panukalang Magna Carta; hindi itinuturo bilang entitlement ang proposed amounts.

## [practice] Kathang-isip na Card A/Card B

Card A: may boluntaryong BHW na nag-ulat ng posibleng panganib sa trabaho. Hindi pa alam ang akreditasyon, rehistrasyon, tamang validation at lokal na approval. Card B: may BHW na naglilingkod sa loob ng isolated BHS upang available anumang oras. Hindi pa alam ang katayuan, pagkain sa tungkulin at lokal na computation/approval. Hindi patunay ng entitlement ang alinmang card.

Sa pares, pumili ng card. Pangalanan ng speaker ang benepisyo, ipaliwanag ang shared at specific conditions, at magtanong ng isang useful verification question. Tingnan ng listener kung may unsupported promise. Magpalit ng card at papel; mag-present ang dalawang pares. Blankong question sheets lamang. Tunay na opsyonal ang personal na karanasan; walang hihinging pribadong application, payment o benefit records.

## [answer-key] Application check at lahat ng dahilan

Tama ang una: kailangan sa hazard allowance ang validated exposure na kaugnay ng tungkulin, kasama ang katayuan/rehistrasyon at applicable board review. Makatwirang unang hakbang ang pagtanong sa RHU ng contact para sa ebidensiya at awtoridad; hindi RHU ang pumapalit sa validation at approval authorities.

Mali ang ikalawa: hindi ginagawang awtomatiko o pare-pareho ng batas ang lahat ng allowance. Magkakaiba ang kondisyon at awtoridad na nagtatakda nito; walang known amount na ibinigay.

Mali ang ikatlo: hindi napapatunayan ng rehistrasyon o isang credential ang exposure, lahat ng kondisyon, local review, CSC eligibility o personal na loan entitlement. Hindi nito pinapalitan ang tiyak na verification.

## [observe] Pagmamasid at competency

Gamitin ang iisang objective-index-0 indicator sa Card A/B. Obserbahan ang grouped actions: pangalanan/ipaliwanag ang anim na kategorya na maaaring tingnan sa listahan; ihiwalay ang shared status/registration at kondisyon ng napiling benepisyo; pangalanan ang awtoridad/contact at verification question; umiwas sa garantiya, imbentong local quota at pagsisi. Hiwalay ang online completion sa observed competency.

Kaya na: tamang paliwanag at tiyak na verification nang walang untag. Kailangan pa ng practice: tama ang direksiyon pero kailangan ng untag sa kondisyon, provider o ebidensiya. Hindi pa: nagpapatuloy ang awtomatikong/pantay na bayad, credential-only entitlement, imbentong quota o pagsisi, o hindi maiugnay ang benepisyo sa verification. Magbigay ng isang lakas at isang actionable next step.

## [support] Suporta at muling pagsasanay

Sentence frame: “Kasama sa RA 7883 ang ___. Kailangan ang rehistrasyon kung saan naglilingkod, at kailangan din sa benepisyong ito ang ___. Itatanong ko sa ___ kung paano matitiyak ang ___; hindi ko maipapangako ang ___.” Magsimula sa isang kategorya at kondisyon, saka idagdag ang iba gamit ang listahan. Magbigay ng supportive paired practice at muling obserbahan sa contrasting card. Maaaring ulitin ang maling unang sagot; walang kailangang personal na disclosure.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at review notes

private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Explain and apply benefits and conditions using Demi’s fictional case. Name the six statutory categories, distinguish registration/accreditation and benefit-specific conditions, and choose a proportionate verification step without promising money. There is one lesson objective, index 0.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

Retain 30 minutes from the existing module’s 180-minute plan: opening 3, worked explanation 8, Card A/B practice 10, check and feedback 5, observation and re-practice 4. This split is authored. Self-study is an authored 10–12-minute estimate, excluding optional story/replay time. The manual recommends three hours for the whole competency, not each lesson. Materials: six-category list, fictional Card A/Card B below, blank question sheets, markers and Read/Slides. No personal records or receipt checklist is required.

## [prepare] Prepare

Read both languages and the audited RA 7883 sections 4–7. Confirm current implementation and appropriate contacts with the local health board/LGU and relevant provider before delivery. Record only verified information; label unknown procedures as unknown. Hazard amount involves the board and peace and order council; subsistence computation involves the LGU. Verify current national implementing rules and local procedures independently; the old DOH FAQ is a summary, not the complete IRR. Do not calculate barangay slots from the nationwide cap or transplant another LGU’s forms. Keep sibling lesson times unchanged.

## [opening] Opening

Read Demi’s fictional claim: “Every BHW gets the same allowance automatically.” Invite a response about the claim, without asking anyone’s registration or benefit history. Say: “We can respect the question and check the conditions. Not receiving a benefit proves no fault.”

## [steps] Steps

1. Show the six categories in section-3: hazard, subsistence, training/education/career enrichment, civil service eligibility, free legal services and preferential loan access. Group as allowances, development and support. Explain education opportunities, the conditional child tuition scholarship, duty-connected PAO services and organized-group health-supporting projects for loans. These are not six monthly cash payments.
2. Explain section 4 registration with the city/municipal board where service is rendered and appropriate proof of accreditation. Section 6 covers accredited BHWs actively and regularly performing duties plus each benefit’s conditions. One credential is insufficient for all benefits. Section 7 adds board review/approval where local funds are spent.
3. Explain section 5: DOH sets the ideal BHW-to-household ratio; the one-percent population cap is nationwide. It is no invented barangay quota or personal eligibility decision.
4. Work Card A: possible foreseeable but unavoidable risk during duty requires proper-authority validation; amount is determined by the local health board and peace and order council. Ask who can identify current evidence and validation contacts. Do not validate exposure yourself.
5. Work Card B: service within an isolated BHS to be available at any and all times; allowance corresponds to meals during duty, computed by the LGU according to prevailing circumstances. A distant home alone is insufficient. Ask which service evidence and local computation apply.
6. Model Demi’s question about benefit, status/evidence, conditions and authority. RHU/supervisor can identify a contact, without replacing statutory authorities. Signpost CSC eligibility to 1.4.3. Offer the story as optional.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers and supportive feedback

“Hazard and subsistence have different conditions; check validation for A and isolated-station service for B.” Respond: “You distinguished the benefit and condition. Now name the appropriate contact and what to verify.”

“Registration is enough for everything.” Respond: “Registration is required. Add active, regular duties, the specific benefit condition and local-fund review where applicable.”

“A non-recipient must have failed to register.” Respond: “We cannot infer that. Check facts and implementation without blame.”

“PAO handles every unrelated case” or “every individual gets a loan.” Respond: “Connect the case with BHW duties; connect loan access with organized groups and qualifying health-supporting projects.” Do not demand recall of every clause on first attempt; allow the list as a reference.

## [misconception] Common misconception

All benefits are automatic, identical allowances. Registration/accreditation alone establishes every payment. A national cap determines local slots. Correct with the relevant sections and evidence, without inventing money, quotas or approval. Enacted law and a proposed Magna Carta are different; proposed amounts are not taught as entitlements.

## [practice] Fictional Card A/Card B practice

Card A: a volunteer BHW reports possible work-related danger. Accreditation, registration, proper validation and local approval are unknown. Card B: a BHW serves within an isolated BHS for service availability at all times. Status, meals during duty and local computation/approval are unknown. Neither card establishes entitlement.

In pairs, choose a card. Speaker names the relevant benefit, explains shared and specific conditions, and asks one useful verification question. Listener checks for unsupported promises. Swap cards and roles, then two pairs present. Use blank question sheets only. Personal experiences are genuinely optional; no private application, payment or benefit records are requested.

## [answer-key] Application check and all rationales

First choice is correct: hazard allowance depends on properly validated duty-related exposure alongside status/registration and applicable board review. Asking the RHU for the appropriate evidence/authority contact is a reasonable first step; the RHU does not itself replace validation or approval authorities.

Second choice is incorrect: the law does not make all allowances automatic or identical. Different conditions and authorities determine the allowances; no known amount is provided.

Third choice is incorrect: registration or one credential does not establish exposure, every benefit condition, local review, CSC eligibility or a personal loan entitlement. A credential cannot replace the specific verification.

## [observe] Observation and competency

Use the single objective-index-0 indicator during Card A/B practice. Observe grouped actions: name/explain the six categories with the list available; distinguish shared status/registration and the chosen benefit’s conditions; identify the appropriate authority/contact and verification question; avoid guarantees, local quota inventions and blame. Online completion is separate from observed competency.

Kaya na: accurate explanation and specific verification without prompting. Kailangan pa ng practice: correct direction but needs prompts for conditions, provider or evidence. Hindi pa: persists with automatic/equal payment, credential-only entitlement, invented quota or blame, or cannot connect the benefit with a verification step. Give one strength and one actionable next step.

## [support] Support and re-practice

Sentence frame: “RA 7883 includes ___. Registration where service is rendered is required, and this benefit also needs ___. I will ask ___ to identify how to verify ___; I cannot promise ___.” Start with one category and its condition, then use the reference list to add the others. Provide supportive paired practice and re-observe the contrasting card. An incorrect first attempt can be practised again; no personal disclosure is required.

levels.kaya_na_en: Accurate categories, shared and specific conditions, and specific verification without prompts or promises.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot yet connect benefits with conditions and verification, or persists with guarantees, invented quotas or blame.
levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang kategorya, shared at specific conditions, at tiyak na verification nang walang untag o pangako.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa maiugnay ang benepisyo sa kondisyon at verification, o nagpapatuloy ang garantiya, imbentong quota o pagsisi.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct direction but needs prompts for conditions, provider or evidence.

read_sections.body_en:
A barangay usually has more than one BHW, and they need to work as a team. Five recommendations guide this.

First, everyone should be clear on why they volunteered — to improve the community's health. Second, each member's role should be clear — who's assigned to which purok, who leads which programme. Third, be open about issues, even personal ones — talk about them right away before they deepen. Fourth, be open to feedback and opinions from teammates or the community — treat it as help, not an attack. Fifth, build relationships with teammates outside of work too — it helps team bonding.
read_sections.body_fil:
Kadalasan ay higit sa isang BHW ang isang barangay, at kailangan nilang magtrabaho bilang isang koponan. Limang rekomendasyon ang gagabay dito.

Una, dapat malinaw sa lahat kung bakit sila nag-volunteer — upang mapabuti ang kalusugan sa komunidad. Pangalawa, dapat malinaw ang tungkulin ng bawat miyembro — sino ang naka-assign sa aling purok, sino ang lead sa aling programa. Pangatlo, maging bukas sa isyu, kahit personal — agad itong pag-usapan bago pa ito lumalim. Pang-apat, maging bukas sa puna at opinyon mula sa kasamahan o sa komunidad — tingnan ito bilang tulong, hindi atake. Panglima, bumuo ng ugnayan sa mga kasamahan kahit sa labas ng trabaho — nakakatulong ito sa bonding ng koponan.
read_sections.takeaway_en: A clear purpose and clear roles build the team; staying open to issues and feedback is what keeps it together.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang malinaw na layunin at tungkulin ang bumubuo ng koponan; ang pagiging bukas sa isyu at puna ang nagpapanatili nito.

private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin

Sa pagtatapos ng maikling araling ito, kaya ng BHW na pangalanan ang limang rekomendasyon para sa mabuting pagtutulungan ng mga BHW at, sa isang team role-play, maipag-usapan nang maaga at malinaw ang isyung nakaaapekto sa team — at masabi kung may kailangang tiyakin sa supervisor.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

- **Oras:** mga 60 minuto sa harapang sesyon — ang bahaging "Ano ang mabuting teamwork" (30 min) at "Team-building activity" (30 min) sa plano sa gabay ng subchapter. Mga 5 minuto ang sariling pag-aaral ng aralin.
- **Kagamitan:** manila paper at marker; ang slides ng aralin; para sa team-building game, lubid, kumot, o masking tape para markahan ang lumiliit na espasyo sa sahig (sinking vessel), o, bawat maliit na grupo, 20 hilaw na spaghetti stick, masking tape, isang metrong tali, at isang marshmallow (marshmallow spaghetti tower); isang role-play card (tingnan sa ibaba).

## [prepare] Paghahanda

- Basahin ang aralin sa Read at Slides para alam mo mismo ang nakita ng BHW.
- Pumili ng isang team-building game at ihanda ito bago ang sesyon. Magbakante ng espasyo sa sahig para sa sinking vessel, o maghanda ng isang kit bawat grupo para sa marshmallow tower.
- Isipin kung paano hinahati ng mga BHW team sa inyong lugar ang trabaho (bawat purok o sitio, lead ng programa) para may totoong halimbawa ka ng "malinaw na tungkulin."
- Ang araling ito ay tungkol sa **pagtutulungan ng mga BHW**. Huwag gawing counselling sa personal na problema ng sinuman ang talakayan sa isyu; ang hinihingi lang ng aralin ay pag-usapan nang maaga ang isyung nakaaapekto sa team.

## [opening] Pambungad

Itanong sa grupo: *"Alalahanin ang panahong napakaganda ng pagtutulungan ng inyong BHW team — at ang panahong hindi. Ano ang pinagkaiba?"* Gumawa ng dalawang hanay sa manila paper, "umubra" at "hindi umubra," at punan mula sa mga sagot.

## [steps] Mga hakbang

1. **Ano ang mabuting teamwork (Read "Ano ang mabuting teamwork", ang slide na may parehong pamagat).** Isa-isahin ang limang rekomendasyon: malinaw na layunin (bakit tayo nag-volunteer), malinaw na tungkulin (sino ang naka-assign sa aling purok, sino ang lead sa aling programa), pagiging bukas sa isyu, pagiging bukas sa puna, at ugnayan sa labas ng trabaho.
2. **Itugma sa pambungad.** Sa bawat rekomendasyon, ituro ang isang bagay sa hanay na "umubra" o "hindi umubra" na tugma dito. Itanong: *"Aling rekomendasyon ang nawala noong hindi umubra?"*
3. **Talakayan ng grupo.** Itanong: *"Alin sa limang rekomendasyon ang pinakamahirap sundin sa inyong karanasan? Bakit?"* Hayaang sumagot ang ilang BHW bago ka magkomento.
4. **Team-building activity.** Gawin ang sinking vessel game (pananatilihin ng team ang lahat sa loob ng espasyo sa sahig na unti-unti mong pinapaliit) o ang marshmallow spaghetti tower (bawat maliit na grupo ay gagawa ng pinakamataas na tore gamit ang kit). Pagkatapos, itanong: *"Sino ang gumanap ng aling papel? Malinaw ba ang layunin? Ano ang nangyari noong may hindi sumang-ayon?"*
5. **Self-check.** Ibigay ang check (ano ang gagawin sa isyung nakaaapekto sa team) at hayaang mag-usap ang grupo bago ibigay ang sagot.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot at paano tumugon

- **"Pinakamahirap ang maging bukas sa isyu — may nagtatampo."** Tapat ito. Sang-ayunan na mahirap, saka ituro ang aralin: agad itong pag-usapan bago pa lumalim. Itanong: *"Ano ang lumalala kapag naghintay tayo?"*
- **"Parang atake ang puna ng komunidad."** Kilalanin ang damdamin. Gamitin ang salita ng aralin: tingnan ang puna bilang tulong, hindi atake. Itanong: *"Ano ang isang punang kalaunan ay nakatulong pala?"*
- **"Isumbong na lang natin sa midwife ang miyembrong may problema."** Huwag balewalain. Itanong: *"Nakausap na ba natin muna ang miyembro at ang team?"* Ang sagot ng module ay pag-usapan agad bilang koponan bago mag-ulat.

## [misconception] Karaniwang maling akala

**"Mas tahimik ang team kapag hindi pinag-uusapan ang problema."** Maraming BHW ang umiiwas magbukas ng isyu para walang masaktan. Kabaligtaran ang sinasabi ng aralin: pag-usapan agad ang isyu bago pa lumalim — kahit personal, kapag nakaaapekto sa trabaho. Itama ito nang hindi napapahiya ang sinuman: itanong sa grupo kung ano ang nangyari sa hanay na "hindi umubra" noong pinabayaan ang isyu, para sa sarili nilang kuwento manggaling ang patunay.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Pagkatapos ng team-building game, gamitin ang role-play card na ito sa mga grupong tatlo o apat: *"Sa inyong BHW team, dalawang linggo nang hindi nabibisita ang purok na naka-assign sa isang miyembro. Napansin na ito ng iba at nagsisimula nang magreklamo sa isa't isa."* Isang BHW ang gaganap na miyembro; ang iba ang team. May tatlong minuto ang grupo para sa usapan. Pagkatapos, ipapaliwanag ng isang BHW bawat grupo, sa sariling salita: ang pangunahing punto (ano ang isyu at bakit ito nakaaapekto sa team), ang unang hakbang na ginawa nila, at ano ang titiyakin nila sa midwife (halimbawa, kung kailangang baguhin ang assignment, dahil ang midwife ang nagtatakda ng gawain ng mga BHW).

## [answer-key] Susi sa self-check

Iisang tanong ang section check sa Read "Ano ang mabuting teamwork" at ang check sa slide ng aralin; minsan lang itong tinalakay dito.

- **"Ano ang gagawin sa isyung nakaaapekto sa team?"** → **Pag-usapan nang maaga at malinaw kasama ang team.** Ang ikatlong rekomendasyon ng aralin ay maging bukas sa isyu, kahit personal, at agad itong pag-usapan bago pa lumalim.
  - Mali ang *"Balewalain hanggang lumala"* dahil sa paghihintay ay lumalalim ang hindi pagkakaunawaan at naaapektuhan ang trabaho ng buong team — iyan mismo ang iniiwasan ng rekomendasyon.

## [observe] Ano ang oobserbahan

Gamitin ang observation indicator ng aralin (naipapaliwanag ang pangunahing punto at angkop na unang hakbang sa sitwasyon, kasama ang dapat tiyakin sa supervisor) habang ginagawa ang role-play:

- **Kaya na:** napapangalanan ng BHW ang isyu at kung bakit ito nakaaapekto sa team, binubuksan ang usapan nang maaga at magalang sa miyembro, at nasasabi kung may titiyakin sa midwife — nang walang untag.
- **Kailangan pa ng practice:** naibubukas ng BHW ang isyu pero kailangan pa ng tanong mo bago masabi kung bakit ito mahalaga sa team o ano ang titiyakin sa midwife.
- **Hindi pa:** hindi angkop ang paliwanag o hakbang — halimbawa, iniiwasan ang isyu, sinisisi ang miyembro nang hindi kinakausap, o dumiretso sa pag-uulat nang hindi muna kinakausap ang miyembro o ang team.

Ipinapakita ng team-building game ang pagtutulungan ng grupo, pero sa role-play obserbahan ang bawat BHW. Hiwalay ang pag-obserba nito sa silid sa pagtatapos ng BHW sa online self-check. Hindi patunay ng kasanayan ang tamang sagot sa self-check.

## [support] Kung kailangan ng dagdag na suporta

- Bigyan sila ng pambungad na linya: *"Puwede ba nating pag-usapan ang pagbisita sa purok? Gusto kong maayos natin ito nang magkasama bago pa lumaki."*
- Hayaan silang panoorin ang isang grupong **Kaya na**, saka ulitin ang parehong card sa bagong grupo.
- Obserbahan muli gamit ang parehong role-play card sa bahaging "Pagsasanay at buod" ng module, o sa susunod na sesyon.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagrepaso

- BHW Reference Manual PDF 17 (Team Work) at Facilitator Guide PDF 26–27 (mga source ng aralin, may markang "inherited page reference; final audit pending"). Ayon sa README ng source material, ang Team Work + Self-Management ay nasa Reference Manual pp. 9–10 (PDF 17–18), Facilitator Guide p. 20 (PDF 27), at Day 1 presentation slides 47–55.
- Galing sa Facilitator Guide PDF 27 ang sinking vessel at marshmallow spaghetti tower, pati ang mungkahing magbahagi ang mga BHW ng karanasan sa pakikipagtrabaho sa kapwa BHW. Ang mga TESDA learning outcome na nakalista roon: describe team role and scope; identify one's role and responsibility within the team; work as a team member.
- Oras: pinananatili ng module ang 3 oras ng TESDA para sa *Work in a Team Environment* (sinasabi ng Facilitator Guide PDF 26–27 na "at least 3 hours", kasama ang paksang "Ang BHW at ang Kanyang Barangay"). Ang 60 minuto sa itaas ay bahagi ng araling ito sa planong iyon (30 min talakayan + 30 min team-building). Huwag idagdag muli ang buong oras sa bawat maikling aralin; ang hating ito ay para sa self-study, hindi bagong training-hour allocation.
- Pangkalahatan ang observation indicator ng araling ito; mas tiyak ang indicator para sa layuning ito sa mga indicator ng kakayahan ng subchapter (naipapakita ang hindi bababa sa tatlo sa limang rekomendasyon sa role-play). Maaaring pagtugmain ito ng mga reviewer.
- Draft na gabay sa talakayan ang `practice-map` na visual ng aralin, hindi pa aprubado ng may-ari.
- Repasuhin ang kasalukuyang legal/policy wording, bilingual parity, at observation indicator bago ilathala.
- Draft para sa pagrepaso (Draft for review)
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

By the end of this short lesson the BHW can name the five recommendations for good teamwork among BHWs and, in a team role-play, bring up an issue affecting the team early and clearly — and say what, if anything, needs to be checked with the supervisor.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

- **Time:** about 60 minutes in a face-to-face session — the "What good teamwork looks like" (30 min) and "Team-building activity" (30 min) parts of the plan in the subchapter guide. Self-study of the lesson alone takes about 5 minutes.
- **Materials:** manila paper and markers; the lesson's slides; for the team-building game, either a rope, blanket or masking tape to mark a shrinking floor space (sinking vessel), or, per small group, 20 uncooked spaghetti sticks, masking tape, a one-meter string and one marshmallow (marshmallow spaghetti tower); one role-play card (see below).

## [prepare] Prepare

- Read the lesson in both Read and Slides so you know exactly what the BHW has seen.
- Choose one team-building game and set it up before the session. Clear floor space for the sinking vessel game, or pack one kit per group for the marshmallow tower.
- Think of how BHW teams in your area divide work (by purok or sitio, by programme lead) so you can use a real example for "clear roles".
- This lesson is about **how BHWs work together**. Do not turn the issue discussion into counselling on anyone's personal problem; the lesson only asks that issues affecting the team be talked about early.

## [opening] Opening

Ask the group: *"Think of a time your BHW team worked really well together — and a time it didn't. What was different?"* Write two columns on manila paper, "worked well" and "didn't", and fill them in from the answers.

## [steps] Steps

1. **What good teamwork looks like (Read "What good teamwork looks like", the slide of the same name).** Go through the five recommendations one at a time: clear purpose (why we volunteered), clear roles (who is assigned to which purok, who leads which programme), openness about issues, openness to feedback, and relationships outside work.
2. **Match to the opening.** For each recommendation, point to something in the "worked well" or "didn't" column that fits it. Ask: *"Which recommendation was missing when it didn't work?"*
3. **Group discussion.** Ask: *"Which of the five recommendations is hardest to follow in your experience? Why?"* Let several BHWs answer before you comment.
4. **Team-building activity.** Run the sinking vessel game (the team keeps everyone inside a floor space that you gradually shrink) or the marshmallow spaghetti tower (each small group builds the tallest tower they can with the kit). Afterwards ask: *"Who took which role? Was the goal clear? What happened when someone disagreed?"*
5. **Self-check.** Give the check (what to do about an issue affecting the team) and let the group discuss before revealing the answer.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers and how to respond

- **"Being open about issues is the hardest — people get offended."** This is honest. Agree that it is hard, then point to the lesson: talk about it right away, before it deepens. Ask: *"What gets worse if we wait?"*
- **"Feedback from the community feels like an attack."** Acknowledge the feeling. Use the lesson's words: treat feedback as help, not an attack. Ask: *"What was one piece of feedback that later turned out to be useful?"*
- **"We should just report the problem member to the midwife."** Do not dismiss it. Ask: *"Have we talked with the member and the team first?"* The module's answer is to talk about it as a team right away, before reporting.

## [misconception] Common misconception

**"Keeping quiet about a team problem keeps the peace."** Many BHWs avoid raising issues so no one is hurt. The lesson says the opposite: talk about issues right away, before they deepen — even personal ones that affect the work. Correct it without embarrassing anyone: ask the group what happened in the "didn't work" column when an issue was left alone, so the evidence comes from their own stories.

## [practice] Practice activity

After the team-building game, use this role-play card in groups of three or four: *"In your BHW team, one member's assigned purok has not been visited for two weeks. Others have noticed and are starting to complain among themselves."* One BHW plays the member; the others play the team. The group has three minutes to hold the conversation. Then one BHW from each group explains, in their own words: the main point (what the issue is and why it affects the team), the first action they took, and what they would check with the midwife (for example, if assignments need to change, since the midwife sets BHWs' tasks).

## [answer-key] Self-check answer key

The section check in Read "What good teamwork looks like" and the check on the lesson's slide are the same question; it is covered once here.

- **"What should you do about an issue affecting the team?"** → **Discuss it early and clearly with the team.** The lesson's third recommendation is to be open about issues, even personal ones, and talk about them right away before they deepen.
  - *"Ignore it until it worsens"* is wrong because waiting lets the misunderstanding deepen and affects the whole team's work — the exact thing the recommendation is meant to prevent.

## [observe] What to observe

Use the lesson's observation indicator (explains the main point and an appropriate first action, including what must be checked with the supervisor) during the role-play:

- **Kaya na:** the BHW names the issue and why it affects the team, opens the conversation early and respectfully with the member, and says what (if anything) to check with the midwife — without prompting.
- **Kailangan pa ng practice:** the BHW raises the issue but needs your follow-up question to say why it matters to the team or what to check with the midwife.
- **Hindi pa:** the explanation or action does not fit — for example, the BHW avoids the issue, blames the member without talking, or goes straight to reporting without speaking to the member or team first.

The team-building game shows the group working together, but observe individual BHWs in the role-play. Observing this in the room is separate from the BHW finishing the online self-check. A correct self-check answer is not evidence of the skill.

## [support] If a BHW needs more support

- Give them an opening line to start with: *"Can we talk about the purok visits? I want us to sort it out together before it gets bigger."*
- Let them watch one group that rated **Kaya na**, then try the same card again in a new group.
- Re-observe with the same role-play card during the "Exercise and summary" part of the module, or at the next session.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

- BHW Reference Manual PDF 17 (Team Work) and Facilitator Guide PDF 26–27 (lesson sources, marked "inherited page reference; final audit pending"). The source-material README maps Team Work + Self-Management to Reference Manual pp. 9–10 (PDF 17–18), Facilitator Guide p. 20 (PDF 27) and Day 1 presentation slides 47–55.
- The sinking vessel and marshmallow spaghetti tower games, and the suggestion to have BHWs share experiences working with fellow BHWs, are from Facilitator Guide PDF 27. The TESDA learning outcomes listed there are: describe team role and scope; identify one's role and responsibility within the team; work as a team member.
- Timing: the module keeps TESDA's 3 hours for *Work in a Team Environment* (Facilitator Guide PDF 26–27 says "at least 3 hours", shared with the "Ang BHW at ang Kanyang Barangay" topic). The 60 minutes above is this lesson's share of that plan (30 min discussion + 30 min team-building). Do not repeat the whole allocation for each short lesson; this split supports self-study and does not create a new training-hour allocation.
- This lesson's observation indicator is generic; the subchapter's competency indicators include a more specific indicator for this objective (demonstrating at least three of the five recommendations in a role-play). Reviewers may want to align them.
- The lesson's `practice-map` visual is a draft discussion guide, not owner-approved.
- Review current legal/policy wording, bilingual parity and the observation indicator before publication.
- Draft for review

lesson.title_en: The legal basis of the role
objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: legal na batayan ng tungkulin.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: the legal basis of the role.

read_sections.body_en:
In this fictional story, Demi helps with community health activities. An acquaintance says: “You have helped for a long time and were invited, so you must already be a recognized BHW.” Demi wonders: are experience and an invitation enough?

Instead of guessing, she asks the health team about the legal basis and how to verify her training and accreditation. Her status has not yet been established. The story video is optional; you can complete Read or Slides without watching it.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa kathang-isip na kuwento, tumutulong si Demi sa mga gawaing pangkalusugan ng komunidad. Sinabi ng isang kakilala: “Matagal ka nang tumutulong at inanyayahan ka naman, kaya tiyak na kinikilalang BHW ka na.” Napaisip si Demi: sapat na ba ang karanasan at paanyaya?

Sa halip na manghula, nagtanong siya sa health team kung ano ang legal na batayan at paano matitiyak ang kaniyang pagsasanay at akreditasyon. Hindi pa natin alam ang kaniyang katayuan. Opsyonal ang kuwentong video; maaaring tapusin ang Read o Slides nang hindi ito pinapanood.
read_sections.heading_fil: Ano ang batayan ng katayuan ni Demi?
read_sections.takeaway_en: Ask about the legal basis; do not assume status.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Magtanong tungkol sa legal na batayan; huwag ipagpalagay ang katayuan.

read_sections.body_en:
Republic Act 7883 is the Barangay Health Workers’ Benefits and Incentives Act of 1995. Section 3 defines a BHW as a person who has undergone training programs under an accredited government or nongovernment organization. The person voluntarily provides primary health care services in the community after accreditation to function as a BHW by the local health board, following Department of Health guidelines.

This is a plain-language explanation of the definition, not a direct quotation. Goodwill or length of service alone does not establish that status. This does not say that RA 7883 created every barangay health station.
read_sections.body_fil:
Ang Republic Act 7883 ay ang Barangay Health Workers’ Benefits and Incentives Act of 1995. Sa seksiyon 3, ang BHW ay taong dumaan sa mga programang pagsasanay sa ilalim ng akreditadong organisasyong pampamahalaan o di-pampamahalaan. Boluntaryo siyang nagbibigay ng primary health care services sa komunidad matapos ma-akreditang gumanap bilang BHW ng local health board, ayon sa mga gabay ng Department of Health.

Payak na paliwanag ito ng depinisyon, hindi direktang sipi. Hindi sapat ang kabutihang-loob o tagal ng pagtulong lamang upang patunayan ang katayuang iyon. Hindi rin nito sinasabi na ang RA 7883 ang batas na nagtatag ng bawat barangay health station.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Training, voluntary service and accreditation belong together in the definition.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Magkaugnay ang pagsasanay, boluntaryong serbisyo at akreditasyon sa depinisyon.

read_sections.body_en:
People and offices have different roles. A training provider can help clarify the training record. A supervisor or RHU can identify the current local contact and process. Section 3, however, identifies the local health board as the accreditation authority under DOH guidelines.

Demi does not accredit herself. A fellow BHW’s agreement or a supervisor’s invitation is insufficient proof of a board decision. Ask what evidence and official record can be checked with the appropriate local office; do not invent a document or procedure.
read_sections.body_fil:
May magkakaibang papel ang mga tao at tanggapan. Maaaring tulungan ng training provider na linawin ang rekord ng pagsasanay. Maaaring ituro ng supervisor o RHU ang kasalukuyang lokal na contact at proseso. Ngunit ang local health board ang tinutukoy ng seksiyon 3 bilang awtoridad sa akreditasyon, alinsunod sa mga gabay ng DOH.

Hindi inaakreditahan ni Demi ang sarili. Hindi rin sapat ang pagsang-ayon ng kapwa BHW o ang paanyaya ng supervisor bilang patunay ng desisyon ng board. Itanong kung anong ebidensiya at opisyal na rekord ang maaaring tingnan sa tamang lokal na tanggapan; huwag mag-imbento ng dokumento o proseso.
read_sections.heading_fil: Sino ang tumutulong, at sino ang nag-aakredita?
read_sections.takeaway_en: Process support and accreditation authority are different roles.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Iba ang tumutulong sa proseso sa awtoridad na nag-aakredita.

read_sections.body_en:
Under section 4 of RA 7883, registration with the local health board of the city or municipality where the BHW serves is required for the Act’s benefits and incentives. It also provides for appropriate proof of accreditation. Individual benefits have further conditions; an invitation is insufficient grounds to promise an allowance.

Civil Service Commission Barangay Health Worker Eligibility has separate conditions and an application. BHW accreditation is not an automatic government appointment or a professional clinical licence. Later lessons cover benefits, eligibility and the accreditation process. Here, first understand the distinctions and the proper authority.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa seksiyon 4 ng RA 7883, ang rehistrasyon sa local health board ng lungsod o munisipyo kung saan naglilingkod ang BHW ay kailangan para sa mga benepisyo at insentibo sa batas. Binabanggit din dito ang angkop na patunay ng akreditasyon. May mga kondisyon pa ang bawat benepisyo; hindi sapat ang isang paanyaya upang mangako ng allowance.

Iba rin ang Barangay Health Worker Eligibility ng Civil Service Commission: may sariling kondisyon at aplikasyon ito. Hindi awtomatikong appointment o propesyonal na clinical licence ang akreditasyon bilang BHW. Sa mga susunod na aralin tatalakayin ang benepisyo, eligibility at proseso ng akreditasyon. Dito, unawain muna ang pagkakaiba at tamang awtoridad.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Do not turn accreditation into automatic benefits or an appointment.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Huwag gawing awtomatikong benepisyo o appointment ang akreditasyon.

read_sections.body_en:
Demi explains: “RA 7883 connects training under an accredited organization, voluntary community primary health care, and local health board accreditation under DOH guidelines. Experience alone is insufficient.”

Her first question to the RHU or supervisor is: “Who is the appropriate contact to verify my training record and proof of local health board accreditation?” They may direct her to the local office handling the process. This is a question, not a result or a new application. Use fictional cases in practice; there is no need to share private records or perform a clinical procedure.

Una niyang tanong sa RHU o supervisor: “Sino po ang tamang contact para matiyak ang rekord ng aking pagsasanay at patunay ng akreditasyon ng local health board?” Maaaring ituro siya sa lokal na tanggapang humahawak ng proseso. slides.narration_en:
Republic Act 7883 is the Barangay Health Workers’ Benefits and Incentives Act of 1995. Section 3 defines a BHW as a person who has undergone training programs under an accredited government or nongovernment organization. The person voluntarily provides primary health care services in the community after accreditation to function as a BHW by the local health board, following Department of Health guidelines.

This is a plain-language explanation of the definition, not a direct quotation. Goodwill or length of service alone does not establish that status. This does not say that RA 7883 created every barangay health station.
